title: Remote Home Manager (Member Care and Contractor Coordination, US Home Services)
description:
Harrington Concierge Home Management is a home management company in Essex County, New Jersey, USA. We give homeowners a dedicated home manager who looks after their house for them. That includes booking trusted, licensed contractors, reviewing quotes, checking finished work and keeping a complete record of everything done to the home. Our members are busy professionals, new homeowners, older homeowners and families caring for a parent’s home. Harrington doesn’t do repairs itself. We manage the house and coordinate the right people.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will be the named home manager for our members. When a member needs something, from a leaking faucet to a roof estimate, you are the person they talk to. You will answer calls and messages, find and book the right contractor from our vetted network, keep members updated, and make sure every job is finished and recorded. This is a long-term, full-time role for someone who loves helping people and keeping things organized.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Answer member calls, texts and app messages, including calls our AI receptionist transfers to you

Log every request in our member portal with clear notes, photos and urgency

Find the right contractor from our vetted network, book the appointment and confirm the time with the member

Collect contractor quotes, check them against our guidelines, and explain the options clearly to the member before they d

Follow up until each job is done, collect the invoice and before-and-after photos, and add them to the member’s Home Ledger

Review completed work by photo and flag anything that doesn’t look right

Review members’ guided video walkthroughs using our checklist, and note anything that needs attention

Schedule home visits with our local field visitors and share their reports with members

Send visit summaries to family members when the member’s plan includes it

Keep each member’s home profile, seasonal reminders and upcoming maintenance up to date

Follow our emergency steps exactly. For a gas smell, flooding or anything dangerous, members are told to call 911 or the utility first, then you coordinate help

Reply to every request the same day under our same-day response promise



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Every request answered the same day

Every request logged, updated and closed in the portal

Members feel they have one person who knows their house

Jobs booked quickly with the right contractor, and no surprises on price or timing

Members renew their membership each year



PAY AND BONUSES



3 to 4 USD per hour depending on experience, paid every two weeks by Wise or PayPal

About 520 to 690 USD a month at full time, before bonuses

A quarterly bonus based on member satisfaction and on-time responses

A bonus for every member who renews

Raises as our membership grows and you take on more responsibility



TRAINING



The first two weeks are paid training. You will learn our services, the member portal, our contractor network, our quote guidelines and our emergency steps. The founder will review your first calls and requests with you.



REQUIREMENTS



Excellent written and spoken English, with a warm, calm and professional phone voice

At least 2 years of customer service, client management or coordination experience with US clients

Highly organized; you never let a request slip

Comfortable with CRMs, Google Workspace and learning new software quickly

Good judgment, and knowing when to ask for help

Reliable internet (at least 25 Mbps), a quiet place to work, a good headset and backup power

Able to work US Eastern daytime hours, including one weekend day



NICE TO HAVE



Experience in US property management, real estate, home services, insurance or construction coordination

Basic knowledge of home systems such as plumbing, heating and cooling, roofing and electrical

Experience with Quo (OpenPhone), HubSpot or similar tools



RULES WE FOLLOW



Member privacy comes first. Door codes and key details are kept only in our secure portal and never sent by text or

We give members honest opinions on quotes. You never accept gifts or payments from contractors

We never mark up a contractor’s price; members pay contractors directly

You sign a confidentiality agreement before you start



HOW TO APPLY



To show us you read this post, start your application with the word “LEDGER”. Then include:



Your resume

A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself in English and describing a time you solved a difficult customer problem (a Google Drive or Vocaroo link is fine)

A short description of your experience with US clients, including the industries you’ve worked in



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid 2-hour trial task. You’ll reply in writing to three sample member requests, draft a booking message to a contractor, and compare two sample quotes. After that comes a 30-minute video interview with a short role-play member call.



We look forward to meeting you.

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER



Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD / month (Base) + Aggressive Annual Performance Bonus tied to KPI achievement 

Remote | Full-time | 



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 🎸⚡️



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage). 

Website: 

: 



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take

end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two

category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories.

Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog

expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings. You are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will

make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line

expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars,

external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1. P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership

• Commercial Accountability: Own the Amazon channel P&L end-to-end, steering margin health,

revenue velocity, and net contribution.

• Cost & Margin Decomposition: Deeply analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee

structures (FBA fulfillment, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and overall contribution margin

to inform pricing and operational decisions.

• Capital & TACoS Allocation: Determine and allocate target TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales)

percentage points across specific product lines and ad formats to maintain healthy profitability while

unlocking incremental growth.



2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.)  High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.)  Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.)  Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.)  Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume  & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

- One specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and

scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******



• Base Salary: $3,500 to $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale

managed.

• Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and

growth KPIs.

• Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Distributed team.

• Impact & Ownership: High degree of executive autonomy over a substantial, mature $20M business

line with direct exposure to brand leadership.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥

title: VIDEO EDITORS

Role: Short-Form Video Editor

Working arrangement: Freelance / Part-Time, Ongoing

Workload: Regular, with hours varying depending on workload



About the Role



We are looking for a reliable, creative and efficient video editor to handle short-form video editing and content clipping on an ongoing basis.



The work will primarily involve taking longer-form video content and turning it into engaging, high-quality short-form clips suitable for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



This is not a full-time position, and there won't necessarily be work every day. However, we expect a regular flow of editing requirements and need someone who is available, responsive and able to take on work consistently as it comes in.



We are looking to build a long-term working relationship with someone who can become familiar with our content, style and expectations.



Key Responsibilities



Clip longer-form videos, podcasts, interviews and other content into engaging short-form videos.

Identify the strongest moments, hooks and talking points to create compelling clips.

Edit videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

Add subtitles, captions, relevant graphics, transitions and animations where appropriate.

Ensure edits are well-paced, engaging and professionally presented.

Format content correctly for different social media platforms (primarily 9:16 vertical).

Make revisions and adjustments based on feedback.

Maintain consistency in editing style, quality and branding.

Turn around editing requests within agreed deadlines.

What We're Looking For



Proven experience editing short-form social media content.

Strong understanding of what makes content engaging and keeps viewers watching.

Good eye for identifying interesting moments and creating effective clips.

Excellent attention to detail, particularly with subtitles and timing.

Ability to work independently and manage deadlines.

Good communication and responsiveness.

Reliable availability when editing work is assigned.

Experience with Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar editing software.

Working Arrangement & Expectations



This is an ongoing freelance/part-time arrangement rather than a full-time salaried position.



Work will be provided regularly, although the volume may vary from week to week.

You will need to be available to take on editing tasks as they arise.

We expect clear communication around availability and turnaround times.

Deadlines must be met consistently.

We are looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship rather than occasional one-off projects.

How to Apply



Please provide:



Examples of previous short-form video edits.

A portfolio or links to content you have edited.

Your editing software and experience.

Your availability and typical turnaround times.

Your rates (per clip, per hour or another preferred arrangement).

title: Sales & Operational Manager - Virtual Assistant (Housekeeping Business)
description:
We are a growing U.S. based cleaning and housekeeping company specializing in short-term rental turnovers, including Airbnb properties. We help property owners and hosts maintain consistent cleaning quality, reliable scheduling, and an excellent guest and client experience.



We are looking for a dependable, organized, and proactive Sales and Operations Manager to help manage daily operations, coordinate our cleaning team, communicate with clients, and generate new business.



This role is ideal for someone who takes initiative, communicates confidently, solves problems independently, and wants to grow alongside a developing business.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Sales and Business Development



- Respond to inbound calls,
s, messages, and cleaning inquiries, converting qualified leads into paying customers.

- Make outbound calls and send messages to potential clients, including short-term rental hosts and property managers.

- Generate new leads through social media engagement, cold outreach, referrals, and other organic sales efforts.

- Follow up with prospective and existing clients to build relationships and secure new business.

- Track leads, sales activity, conversion rates, and follow-ups in the company's CRM or tracking systems.

- Provide accurate information about services, answer questions, and confidently communicate the value of GuestMaids.

- Work toward a target sales close rate of 40% or higher.



2. Operations and Customer Service



- Coordinate daily and weekly cleaning schedules to ensure all jobs are assigned and completed on time.

- Communicate with cleaners, monitor progress, and address scheduling needs.

- Handle last-minute cancellations, cleaner call-outs, no-shows, and other operational issues.

- Respond promptly (within 10 minutes) to client inquiries, requests, schedule changes, and minor complaints.

- Monitor ongoing cleaning jobs and ensure reported issues and follow-ups are resolved.

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date schedules in our booking software.

- Monitor cleaner performance and escalate significant issues to the owner when necessary.

- Maintain professional communication with clients, cleaners, and other team members.



3. Cleaner Recruitment and Onboarding



- Maintain and update job descriptions and online job listings for cleaner positions.

- Review applications, communicate with candidates, and conduct initial interviews.

- Assist with recruiting, selecting, and onboarding reliable cleaners.

- Maintain an organized recruitment pipeline to support the company's growth.

- Help ensure new cleaners understand company expectations, cleaning standards, and operational procedures.



4. Marketing and Online Presence



- Manage and update the company's social media accounts.

- Maintain the company's Google Business Profile, including posting updates and responding to reviews.

- Update website content and assist with improving the website's appearance, usability, and search engine optimization (SEO).

- Help develop practical marketing strategies to attract new clients and strengthen the company's online presence.



5. Administrative and Special Projects



- Maintain accurate client records, sales information, schedules, and other business documentation.

- Complete assigned business and administrative tasks within established deadlines.

- Assist with process improvements, documentation (i.e. SOP), and projects that improve operational efficiency.

- Take ownership of assigned tasks and provide updates on progress and outstanding issues.

- Assist with other reasonable business or administrative tasks as needed.



Requirements and Qualifications:



- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally and confidently.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Previous experience in sales, customer service, virtual assistance, operations, or administrative support.

- Comfortable making outbound calls, following up with leads, and selling services over the phone or through messages.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle unexpected situations calmly.

- Comfortable using computers, spreadsheets, online platforms, and business software.

- Willingness to learn and use tools such as Notion, ConvertLabs, Breezeway, CRM systems, scheduling software, and website management platforms.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.

- A proactive mindset: able to identify problems, suggest solutions, and take action without waiting for instructions on every task.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for professional remote work.

- Ability to work effectively in a growing business where priorities and responsibilities may change.



Preferred Qualifications:



- Experience working with U.S.-based clients.

- Experience in the cleaning, housekeeping, Airbnb, or property management industry.

- Experience recruiting and coordinating cleaners or independent contractors.

- Familiarity with social media management, Google Business Profile, website editing, and basic SEO.



Work Schedule:



- Part-time or Full-time position, with the initial schedule agreed upon with the successful candidate.

- Working hours will be coordinated around U.S. Eastern Time (8:30AM to 5:30PM)

- Availability during agreed-upon working hours is important to ensure timely responses to clients and cleaners.



Compensation and Bonuses:



* **Base pay:** Hourly compensation, agreed upon before starting.

* **Payment schedule:** Biweekly payments through Wise.

* **Monthly KPI bonus:** An additional 5% of the month's base pay if all established monthly key performance indicators (KPIs) are met.

* **New revenue bonus:** 1% of new revenue booked. For example, booking $1,000 in new business earns a $10 bonus.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this position will be measured by the following:



Scheduling and reliability: Cleaning jobs are assigned and completed as scheduled, with minimal errors or delays.

Customer service: Client inquiries and messages receive a response within 10 minutes during working hours, whenever reasonably possible.

Customer satisfaction: Clients and guests consistently receive the high-quality service expected from GuestMaids.

Cleaner coordination: Cleaners receive clear communication, feel supported, and have the information needed to complete their assignments successfully.

Sales performance: Maintain a target close rate of 40% or higher for qualified sales leads.

Lead management: Keep sales records updated and ensure prospective clients receive timely follow-ups.

Task completion: Complete assigned responsibilities accurately and within established deadlines.



Work Leave and Communication Expectations:



- Requests for more than two consecutive days off should be submitted at least seven days in advance.

- Other planned time-off requests should be submitted at least 48 hours in advance.

- If leaving the position, the employee is expected to provide at least 14 days' notice.

- Maintain professional communication and notify the owner promptly about absences, delays, or issues affecting work.



Technical Requirements:



- A dedicated workstation at home.

- A stable internet connection of at least 30 Mbps.

- A backup internet solution and access to backup devices or power arrangements when needed.

- A quiet working environment suitable for calls and professional communication.



How to Apply?



Please submit your resume and a brief introduction video (2 minutes or less) introducing yourself and why you are the best candidate for this role? Please send your video to 



We care about more than getting tasks done. We want to build a team of people we can trust to do the right thing, care about others, and take ownership of their work.



Our values guide how we make decisions, communicate, and serve our customers. We’re looking for someone who genuinely identifies with these values and demonstrates them through their daily actions.



1. Excellence

Do the Job Right, Even When No One Is Watching.



We take pride in our work and pay attention to the details. We don't cut corners or wait for someone to check our work. Whether you're updating a cleaning schedule, responding to a customer, following up with a lead, or completing an administrative task, you take responsibility for doing it correctly.



2. Honest and Fair

Tell the Truth and Treat People Right.



We communicate honestly, take responsibility for mistakes, and treat customers, cleaners, and teammates fairly. If something goes wrong, we address it instead of hiding it. We value people who can be trusted to give accurate updates, keep their commitments, and do the right thing even when it's uncomfortable.



3. Care About People

Look Out for Our Customers and Each Other.



Our business depends on trust and strong relationships. We want someone who genuinely cares about helping customers, supporting cleaners, and making things easier for the people they work with. You listen, show empathy, communicate respectfully, and look for solutions that are fair and practical.



4. Always Growing

Keep Learning and Getting Better.



We don't expect you to know everything from day one. We do expect you to be curious, open to feedback, and willing to improve. You learn from mistakes, look for better ways to do things, and take initiative to develop your skills. As GuestMaids grows, we want you to grow with us.



5. Go With the Flow

Adapt Without Losing Your Cool.



Cleaning operations can change quickly. A cleaner might cancel, a customer might change a schedule, or an urgent issue might need attention. We need someone who can adjust priorities, stay calm under pressure, and focus on solving the problem rather than getting frustrated. We value flexibility, practical thinking, and a positive approach to change.



Who We're Looking For



The right person is dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities. You don't need someone reminding you about every task or telling you what to do at every step. You notice what needs attention, communicate when something is wrong, and follow through until the job is done.



You care about the quality of your work, treat people fairly, and understand that small details can make a big difference to customers and the team.



We're looking for someone who wants to be part of a growing business, contribute ideas, solve problems, and build systems that help the company run better over time.



If these values reflect how you naturally work, not just what you think an employer wants to hear, we'd like to meet you!

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
We are a U.S.-based e-commerce company selling professional and industrial equipment to businesses, schools, universities, government organizations and manufacturers.



We are hiring a full-time remote Sales Support Specialist to handle customer calls, follow up on sales inquiries and keep quotations and orders moving. You will work directly with U.S. customers and coordinate with manufacturers and our internal team.



We want someone who takes responsibility for follow-up and is looking for a long-term role.



What you will do



- Answer incoming customer calls and return missed calls.

- Respond to customer inquiries by email.

- Follow up with leads, customers and outstanding quotations.

- Create and send quotations using existing templates.

- Update customer records in Zoho CRM and schedule follow-up activities.

- Assist with order processing and keep customers informed.

- Coordinate communication between customers, manufacturers and internal team members.

- Track open inquiries and sales opportunities so each one receives the appropriate follow-up.



What you need



- Experience dealing directly with customers and handling questions or follow-up.

- Clear spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to customers on the phone.

- Attention to detail when handling customer information, quotations and orders.

- The ability to organize your work, follow instructions and complete follow-up without constant reminders.

- The ability to learn new products, systems and processes.

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for customer calls.

- Availability to start immediately and work the full schedule below.



Preferred experience



We give priority to applicants with phone sales and personal closing experience. Experience with U.S. customers, sales support and CRM software is also useful.



If you have strong customer-service experience but less sales experience, we will still consider you if you can show that you learn quickly. We can teach our products, systems and sales techniques. You should already be comfortable handling customers and managing follow-up.



We value steady employment and are looking for someone who wants to stay and grow in the role.



Pay and working hours



- Starting salary of $800 USD per month.

- Full-time remote position.

- Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM U.S. Pacific time.

- Salary review after successful completion of the probation period.

- Opportunities for growth based on performance.



The schedule follows U.S. Pacific time, including daylight saving changes.



How to apply



Please send:



1. Your resume, with the month and year you started and finished each role.

2. A short written introduction covering your relevant customer-service or sales experience, current work commitments and earliest available start date.

3. A voice recording of 1 to 2 minutes in English. Tell us about your most recent customer-facing role and what you personally did. If you have phone-sales experience, explain what you sold and your role in closing the sale. Speak in your own words.

4. Confirmation that you can start immediately, work the stated schedule and accept the starting salary of $800 USD per month.

title: Social Media Content Assistant / Video Editor
description:
Allegra Bakes is a New York-based children’s baking and education brand. We create baking experiences, workshops, books and products that help children build confidence, independence and creativity through baking.



 We’re looking for a creative, organized and detail-oriented Social Media Content Assistant to help us turn our existing photos and videos into engaging content for Instagram and TikTok.



We have plenty of footage, photographs and content ideas. We need someone who can take these materials and turn them into polished, ready-to-publish posts.



This is a content creation and editing role, not a social media strategy position.



Key Responsibilities



Video Editing



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

* Turn raw baking footage into engaging 15–45-second videos.

* Add appropriate music, text overlays, captions and transitions.

* Repurpose existing videos into multiple pieces of content.

* Create engaging videos that capture attention without excessive effects or editing.



Social Media Content



* Design Instagram carousels and static posts using existing photographs.

* Create Instagram Stories to promote workshops, products and events.

* Draft short, engaging captions that match our brand voice.

* Follow established brand guidelines, including fonts, colors and visual style.



Content Management



* Maintain a simple social media content calendar.

* Organize photos, videos and finished content in Google Drive.

* Prepare and schedule posts for approval.

* Track content progress and meet agreed deadlines.



Content Expectations



Initially, we’re aiming to produce:



* 3–4 Instagram feed posts per week (primarily Reels and carousels).

* 3–5 Instagram Stories per week.

* Repurposed Reels for TikTok.

* A simple, organized weekly content calendar.



Our longer-term goal is to publish daily as we establish an efficient workflow.



Required Skills



* Proven experience editing Instagram Reels and TikTok videos.

* Proficiency in CapCut or similar video editing software.

* Experience creating graphics and carousels in Canva.

* Strong visual design skills and attention to detail.

* Excellent written English.

* Ability to follow creative direction and brand guidelines.

* Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently.

* Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines.



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has a strong eye for clean, modern and visually engaging content.

* Understands Instagram and TikTok trends.

* Enjoys creating content for food, baking, lifestyle or family-focused brands.

* Can work creatively with existing footage rather than needing everything planned out.

* Is proactive, organized and comfortable working independently.

* Is interested in a long-term working relationship.



Experience creating content for food, baking, children’s brands or small businesses would be a bonus.



Hours & Compensation



* Approximately 10 hours per week to start.

* $6–8 USD per hour, depending on experience.

* Flexible working hours.

* Potential to increase hours as the brand grows.

* Long-term opportunity for the right person.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Portfolio: Links to Instagram Reels or TikTok videos you’ve personally edited.

2. Design examples: Two or three Instagram carousels or graphics you’ve created.

3. Tools: Your experience with CapCut, Canva and social media scheduling tools.

4. Availability: Your preferred working hours and availability per week.

5. Rate: Your expected hourly rate.



Paid editing assignment - Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing assignment using our existing footage.



Overall you’ll have plenty of creative material to work with, clear brand guidelines and the opportunity to help shape how our content looks as the business grows.

title: Ready to edit for the big leagues? 🚀
description:
We’re an 8-figure brand spending $100k+ a day on Meta ads.



And we f*cked up. We grew faster than our creative team could keep up.



So we’re hiring a DTC Video Editor. 



But this isn’t just another editing job.



At most places, you get a brief, make the ad, and send it off. Then nothing.



You never see the numbers. Nobody tells you why one ad printed for months while another died on day two. You’re good, but nobody around you is making you better.



Here, that changes.



Who we are:

We’re an 8-figure DTC brand in the grilling space, spending $100k+ a day on Meta. 

We run every format: AI VO + B-roll, founder ads, podcasts, natives, AI animations and statics. We’ve tested it all with real money, and we know what converts.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become one of the best editors in performance advertising.



What you get

→ Performance bonuses

→ Work directly with our creative strategists. No layers of managers

→ Weekly sessions in the ad account: what won, what died, and why

→ Learn the strategy behind the ads, not just the editing. What takes most editors years, you’ll pick up in months

→ Room to grow. Start as an editor, take on more strategy, and your pay grows with it



Who this is for

→ You’ve edited ads for DTC brands and know about awareness stage levels

→ You use AI tools (voice, image and video gen) to level up your edits

→ You’re always asking “why did that one work?”



The details

→ $1,500–$2,500/month base, depending on experience

→ Performance bonuses

→ Full-time, remote, 8 hours a day



This isn’t for everyone

If you think your job is to make ads look nice, this won’t fit. Here, a good ad is one that sells.



But if you’re hungry to get better and want to work on ads that actually scale, we want to hear from you.



To apply, send me:

→ The DTC brands you’ve worked with

→ Your portfolio

→ Your best-performing ad, and why you think it worked

→ If possible, a introduction video

title: Senior Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (Full-Time, $650–$850+/mo)
description:
Full-time · Salary: $650 - $850+ USD/month · Hours: 40/week



We're a YouTube studio making long-form videos about real stories. Real research, no AI slop. We're launching several channels and want an editor to grow with us: steady, full-time, long-term work on videos you'll be proud to put your name on.



This is not an entry-level role. If you're just starting out as an editor, please don't apply.



Compensation depends on your experience and skill level.



Why you'll like it here:

- You get the script, voiceover and image list. You focus on making it great.

- Long-form, creative work, not an endless stream of shorts.

- Clear direction: we show you exactly the style we want.

- Stable monthly pay that reflects your skill.



The style we want: watch the first 3 minutes of this video (it isn't ours): 
/watch?v=BUGy3Eiq8vk



- Mostly still images (old paintings, engravings, archive photos, maps), each brought to life with slow, varied camera moves

- Photo cut-out silhouettes, portrait cards with names, and route maps where a red line draws itself across the sea

- One colour look across the whole video, with red as the only accent

- Hard cuts timed to the narrator's breaths, not a dissolve on every shot

- A clear voice over calm, deep music, with very few sound effects



You'll:

- Turn a script, voiceover and image list into a long-form video

- Find and prepare the images: clean them up, cut out figures and objects, and grade them into one look

- Build the maps, cards and text animations

- Mix the voice, music and the occasional sound effect



You have:

- Long-form YouTube videos you edited, built mostly from still images

- Real motion-graphics skill (After Effects, Fusion or similar). You can make an old engraving feel alive without it looking like a template

- A good eye for old artwork, and the patience to find the right picture for each line



Not a fit if most of your work is short-form, talking heads, gaming, stock-footage montages or slideshow-style videos.



To apply: start your message with "YT" and send:

1. 2–3 long-form videos you edited, built mostly from still images

2. In 1-2 sentences: why do you think you'd be a good fit for this role?

3. Your expected monthly salary



Please send links to the actual videos only. Portfolio sites and portfolio links won't be reviewed.

title: Video Editor who #Believes in Entrepreneurs| Flexible Work Schedule
description:
We're trying to solve the world's biggest problem: People don't #Believe in themselves enough. For over 22 years, Evan Carmichael has been dedicated to this mission. The way we're approaching this problem is producing inspirational content at scale. The right video at the right time can completely change someone's life and we want to touch as many lives as possible. People may not have a supportive family or community around them, but our content can help give them the belief they need to chase their dreams and make the world a better place. We want to work with people who also want to make an impact and touch people's lives. In your application, please put ‘I am your next awesome Video Editor!’ in the subject line. Please apply through OnlineJobsPh and not via
. The job responsibilities include editing the first minute of videos to grab and keep the audience's attention, selecting the most engaging clips, adding eye-catching transitions and effects, ensuring the sound and visuals are top-notch, and staying on top of the latest trends to keep things fresh. Our goal is to get to 70% audience retention in the first minute. Additionally, strong creativity, attention to detail, and effective communication skills are essential to produce high-quality videos that engage viewers and meet retention goals. Please also share the link to your resume and portfolio, what your hourly salary expectations are, and in the first line of your message tell us how many YouTube subscribers Evan Carmichael has, followed by who your favorite entrepreneur of all time is and why. The job is full time (40 hours per week) with a flexible schedule. We would start off with a small project for now and we'd pay you for your ideas and research. We also like to work with people over a long period of time, not just short contracts, and give them opportunities to succeed and do more based on what they want to learn. Hopefully that will be you! Take a peek at what it's like being part of our team - 
  Thank you for reading and good luck! Sending lots of love! -Irish #Believe

title: Sales/Admin
description:
Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant (Strong Closer with Admin Skills) – U.S. Cleaning Business



We are hiring a Sales-Oriented Virtual Assistant who knows how to confidently handle objections and close deals over the phone. You’ll be the first point of contact for leads interested in our U.S.-based cleaning services, and your main goal is to convert those inquiries into paying customers.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in sales conversations, knows how to build trust quickly, and doesn’t shy away from tough questions or hesitations from prospects.



Key Responsibilities:

Take inbound sales calls from interested leads and follow up with outbound calls when needed

Confidently pitch our services and walk customers through pricing and packages

Handle common objections (pricing, scheduling, trust concerns) with professionalism and ease

Convert warm leads into scheduled jobs with a consistent close rate

Manage CRM updates, lead tracking, and post-call notes

Assist with scheduling, follow-up
s, and basic administrative tasks

Maintain excellent customer service before, during, and after the sale



What We're Looking For:

Fluent in English with strong conversational skills

Proven ability to overcome objections and close sales on calls

Comfortable talking to U.S. customers and building rapport quickly

Detail-oriented with solid administrative follow-through

Able to work independently and take initiative without constant supervision

Experience with cleaning or home services (preferred but not required)



Technical Requirements:

Minimum 30 Mbps wired Internet connection

Quiet, professional work environment with no background noise

Backup Internet and device for emergencies



Compensation & Hours:

$6-7 USD per hour (depending on experience)



Full-time role

Must be available during U.S. business hours (Eastern or Pacific time)



To Apply:

Submit a short written or video message describing your experience with handling objections and closing sales over the phone. Real examples or metrics from past roles are a plus.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Compelling Mysteries & Unexplained Encounters
description:
We're looking for an excellent, independent writer to create engaging YouTube scripts about strange sightings, unusual encounters, and unexplained events.



THE STANDARD WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for a writer who can create scripts on the level of MrBallen and Lighthouse Mysteries. Both channels are examples of the storytelling we're looking for: compelling stories, natural language, strong pacing, and details that keep you listening from beginning to end.



We want someone who can take a fascinating mystery and turn it into a complete, engaging script. Someone who knows what to include, what to leave out, and how to make each part of the story interesting. A strong opening matters, but the writing needs to stay strong throughout.



We've been looking for the right writer for a while. The problems we keep encountering are repetition, boring stretches, unnatural wording, and scripts that need substantial rewriting before they can be narrated. We're looking for someone with the judgment and attention to detail to deliver polished work independently.



For the right writer, this could become a long-term role with regular assignments. We want to find someone whose work we're excited to read and who we can keep working with.



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• We provide the topic and writing guidelines for each assignment.



THE ROLE



For paid assignments, you will handle research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading independently. Each finished script needs to be ready to narrate as written, without us having to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



Topics include strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Stories should have safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts should be extremely easy to follow and natural when read aloud, as though you're telling a friend a fascinating story. We want a strong opening, events presented in a clear chronological order, and interesting details that hold attention throughout.



Plain language is essential. No flowery descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive. For example:



• Instead of “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town,” use “The town was quiet.”

• Instead of “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt,” use “The moon lit the road.”

• Instead of “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure,” use “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, repeated points, or padding. Build suspense through the events and details of the story.



Paid scripts must be carefully researched and include source links. Documented facts, witness accounts, and speculation should be presented accurately. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line and include:



1. A brief introduction and any relevant writing experience.

2. Your strongest existing script that demonstrates this level of storytelling. A complete script lets us see how you carry the story from its opening through to its ending. Identify exactly what you wrote and make sure the link is accessible.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



We're looking for a dependable writer with serious attention to detail and the ability to consistently deliver engaging, narration-ready scripts.

title: AI-Powered Marketing Specialist (Content, Google Ads, Meta Ads) for US Real Estate Lender
description:
ABOUT REQUITY GROUP

Requity Group (
) is a US private real estate lender. We fund fix and flip, ground-up construction, DSCR rental, manufactured housing community and land-home loans for real estate investors. We are a small, fast-moving team that builds our own software and uses AI in everything we do. We are building a world-class team in the Philippines and this is a key role.



HOURS: Full time, 40 hours per week. Must overlap at least 4 hours with US Eastern business hours.



THE ROLE

You will own our marketing: content, paid ads, newsletter and social media. You will use AI every day to do the work of a whole marketing team, and use data to d
 what works. But AI is the tool, not the job. The job is to truly understand real estate investors and lending, and make every piece of marketing feel human, useful and trustworthy.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Blog: publish 4 SEO blog posts per week on 
, researched with Semrush and written with AI, then edited by you so they are accurate, plain-spoken and genuinely helpful to real estate investors.

- Google Ads: manage our Google Ads spend, improve campaigns, and send a weekly report on spend, leads, cost per lead and funded loans.

- Meta Ads: manage our
 and Instagram ad spend, including retargeting, and send a weekly report on the same numbers.

- Newsletter: write and send a bi-weekly
 newsletter (market notes, closed loan stories, program updates, helpful tips).

- Social media: grow our presence on LinkedIn, Instagram and
 over time with consistent, real content (closed deals, team, education).

- Tracking: make sure every lead is tagged with where it came from, so we know which marketing turns into funded loans, not just clicks.

- Learn the business: sit in on team calls, learn our loan programs and our borrowers, and bring ideas from what you hear.



WHO YOU ARE

- Excellent written English. You write clearly and simply, with no fluff.

- You already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) heavily in your work and can show us how.

- Hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads with real budgets, and you are comfortable with Google Analytics and spreadsheets.

- SEO experience (keyword research, on-page SEO, WordPress).

- Curious and eager to learn US real estate and lending. Experience in real estate, mortgage, finance or US-facing marketing is a big plus.

- You care about quality and the human touch. You would rather publish one great post than three generic ones.

- Reliable, organized and comfortable owning results with little hand-holding.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive pay, reviewed as you grow

- 13th month pay

- HMO health coverage (after probation)

- Paid time off and Philippine holidays

- Paid AI tools and software

- Long-term role with real ownership and room to grow into marketing lead

- Direct work with the CEO and a team that builds with AI every day



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Your resume

2. Links to 2 or 3 pieces of writing or campaigns you are proud of

3. A short note (under 150 words) on how you use AI in your marketing work, with one specific example

4. One result you achieved with Google or Meta ads (budget, what you did, what happened)

5. A short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself and walking us through one piece of your work. Please do NOT read from a script. We want to see what it is like to talk and work with you, so just be yourself. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



Start your application with the words "Funded Loans" so we know you read the full post.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test project: writing one blog post and reviewing a sample ad report.

title: Business Development & Sales Professionals | Staffing & Recruitment Industry
description:
Business Development & Sales Professionals | Staffing & Recruitment Industry

Full-time · Fully Remote · Based in the Philippines · Potential Direct Hire Opportunities with US Staffing & Recruitment Firms



IMPORTANT: Direct business development or sales experience within the staffing and recruitment industry is mandatory. Applicants whose sales experience is exclusively outside the staffing and recruitment industry will not be considered.



About the Opportunity

Alderstone Partners is expanding its network of experienced Business Development and Sales Professionals based in the Philippines for potential direct hire opportunities with staffing agencies, recruitment firms, and executive search organizations serving the US market.



We are connecting with professionals who have demonstrated experience developing new business, acquiring clients, and building commercial relationships specifically within the staffing and recruitment industry.



This posting is part of our ongoing talent network development and is not tied to a single confirmed vacancy. Our goal is to identify and assess qualified professionals whose experience may align with the future hiring requirements of our partner firms.

Opportunities may include Business Development Representatives, Business Development Managers, Account Executives, Client Acquisition Specialists, Staffing Sales Professionals, and other related commercial roles.



We are particularly interested in professionals who understand how staffing and recruitment firms generate revenue, secure new client accounts, develop hiring relationships, and convert business opportunities into active recruitment engagements.



What You May Be Responsible For

Responsibilities will vary depending on the hiring organization, role, and commercial objectives.

* Identify and research prospective clients that may require staffing, recruitment, executive search, or talent acquisition services.

* Develop new business opportunities through targeted prospecting, cold calling,
 outreach, LinkedIn, referrals, and professional networking.

* Engage hiring managers, talent acquisition leaders, HR executives, business owners, and other decision makers to understand their hiring needs.

* Introduce staffing and recruitment services, communicate their value, and position relevant solutions based on client requirements.

* Qualify prospects by evaluating hiring demand, recruitment challenges, decision making authority, timelines, and potential commercial value.

* Schedule discovery calls, client meetings, and introductory conversations with qualified prospective clients.

* Build and maintain a consistent sales pipeline, progressing opportunities from initial outreach through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and client acquisition.

* Support discussions involving recruitment service agreements, placement fees, staffing arrangements, and commercial terms where applicable.

* Develop relationships with existing clients to identify additional hiring requirements, repeat business, and account expansion opportunities.

* Collaborate with recruitment and delivery teams to align client expectations, hiring requirements, and recruitment capabilities.

* Maintain accurate prospect records, sales activities, client communications, and opportunity updates using CRM platforms.

* Track business development performance through relevant measures such as qualified meetings, sales opportunities, new accounts, job orders, and revenue generation.



What We Are Looking For

* Direct professional experience in business development, sales, client acquisition, or account development specifically within staffing and recruitment organizations.

* Demonstrated experience selling staffing, permanent placement, recruitment process outsourcing, executive search, or related recruitment services.

* Experience prospecting and engaging US companies, hiring managers, HR leaders, talent acquisition teams, or business decision makers.

* Practical understanding of the staffing and recruitment business model, including client acquisition, job order generation, placement fees, and recruitment delivery.

* Experience conducting outbound sales activities, including cold calling,
 prospecting, LinkedIn outreach, and relationship development.

* Ability to identify qualified business opportunities, conduct discovery conversations, and communicate recruitment service offerings effectively.

* Familiarity with staffing sales cycles, client objections, commercial negotiations, and relationship management.

* Experience using CRM platforms, prospecting databases, lead generation tools, and sales engagement systems.

* Strong written and spoken English, with confidence communicating directly with US business stakeholders.

* Ability to work independently, manage a structured sales pipeline, and demonstrate accountability for commercial outcomes.

* Availability to support US business hours depending on the hiring organization's requirements.



Industry experience is a strict requirement. General B2B sales, SaaS sales, real estate sales, insurance sales, retail sales, and other sales backgrounds without direct staffing or recruitment industry sales experience do not meet the minimum qualifications.



Relevant Business Development & Sales Backgrounds

We welcome professionals with experience in one or more of the following areas.



New Business Development

* Staffing Business Development

* Recruitment Agency Sales

* New Client Acquisition

* Outbound Prospecting and Lead Generation

* Recruitment Service Sales



Client Relations & Account Growth

* Staffing Account Management

* Client Relationship Development

* Existing Account Expansion

* Key Account Management

* Recruitment Partnership Development



Specialized Recruitment Markets

* Technology and IT Staffing

* Healthcare and Medical Staffing

* Finance and Accounting Recruitment

* Engineering and Manufacturing Staffing

* Professional and Executive Search

* Industrial, Logistics, and Commercial Staffing



Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area listed. We are primarily interested in the depth of your staffing and recruitment sales experience, your familiarity with the US market, and your ability to contribute to client acquisition and business growth.



What We Value

* Industry knowledge: A practical understanding of how staffing and recruitment firms acquire clients, generate job orders, and develop profitable business relationships.

* Commercial judgment: The ability to identify genuine business opportunities, qualify prospective clients, and prioritize accounts with meaningful growth potential.

* Prospecting expertise: Confidence in reaching decision makers, initiating commercial conversations, and developing relationships with prospective clients.

* Professional communication: Clear and credible conversations with hiring leaders, business owners, and recruitment decision makers.

* Ownership and consistency: Disciplined pipeline management, reliable follow through, and accountability for sales activity and business development results.

* Relationship development: The ability to establish trust, understand client priorities, and maintain productive commercial relationships.



Compensation

Compensation will vary based on the hiring organization, position, relevant staffing and recruitment sales experience, US market exposure, and demonstrated commercial performance. Depending on the opportunity, compensation may include a fixed base salary, performance incentives, commissions, or a combination of these components. Specific compensation details will be discussed when a suitable opportunity becomes available.



Employment Structure

Alderstone Partners connects experienced professionals with staffing and recruitment firms for potential direct employment. When a suitable opportunity becomes available, qualified professionals may be contacted to discuss the position, hiring organization, compensation structure, and employment requirements before proceeding.

Successful candidates will be employed directly by the hiring organization, not Alderstone Partners.



Alderstone Partners facilitates candidate assessment, professional introductions, and hiring coordination. The hiring organization retains responsibility for its recruitment decisions and employment arrangements.



Important Information About Your Application

This posting is intended to identify and engage qualified professionals for Alderstone Partners' growing talent network. It does not represent an immediate opening or guarantee an interview, employment offer, or placement. Applications will be reviewed based on relevant staffing and recruitment industry sales experience, professional background, market exposure, and potential alignment with future client requirements. Qualified candidates may be contacted as suitable opportunities become available. Any introduction to a prospective hiring organization will be discussed with the candidate beforehand.



If you have direct business development or sales experience within the staffing and recruitment industry, we welcome your application and the opportunity to learn more about your background.

title: Senior YouTube Video Editor – Golf Entertainment Series (Long-Form + Shorts)
description:
Senior YouTube Video Editor & Motion Graphics Specialist – Golf Entertainment Series



Job Type: Gig / Project-Based (Potential Long-Term Opportunity)

Location: Remote

Project Duration: 10-Episode Season



About the Project



Lakeland Golf Club is launching The Club Golf Sim League, a new YouTube golf entertainment series filmed in the United States.



Think Bob Does Sports meets Barstool Sports and the Internet Invitational.



The show features 12 golfers competing in a golf simulator league, with plenty of trash talk, comedy, rivalries, and competitive moments.



We’re looking for a talented, creative, and experienced YouTube Video Editor & Motion Graphics Specialist to help bring this series to life.



This isn’t a traditional corporate editing job. We want someone who understands YouTube entertainment, comedic timing, storytelling, sports graphics, and how to keep viewers engaged throughout longer videos.



We’re starting with a 10-episode season. If the series is successful and we work well together, there is an opportunity for continued projects and future seasons.



Project Scope



Season 1 Deliverables:



* 10 professionally edited YouTube episodes (40–60 minutes each)

* 100 short-form videos (10 per episode, approximately 60–90 seconds each)

* Custom animated golf scorecards, leaderboards, and sponsor graphics

* Professional audio enhancement, color grading, and sound design

* Fully editable project files for all completed work



Total: 110 finished videos.



Raw Footage & Show Format



Each episode features two separate 9-hole golf matches.



Each match includes six golfers competing on three teams of two using an alternate-shot format.



We will provide approximately:



* 3 hours of footage from Camera 1 (active golfer)

* 3 hours of footage from Camera 2 (other golfers and reactions)

* 3 hours of GSPro golf simulator gameplay recorded through OBS



That’s approximately nine hours of synchronized footage from a three-hour filming session per episode.



The editor will need to review the footage, identify entertaining moments, and create a polished episode that combines competitive golf with comedy and personality-driven storytelling.



Responsibilities



Long-Form YouTube Editing



* Edit 40–60-minute YouTube episodes with engaging pacing and storytelling

* Synchronize multiple camera angles and gameplay recordings

* Highlight funny conversations, trash talk, reactions, great shots, and terrible shots

* Create engaging introductions, transitions, and episode endings

* Incorporate music, sound effects, replays, zoom-ins, and comedic effects

* Maintain continuity of team scores, league standings, and ongoing storylines



Golf Graphics & Motion Design



Create professional, reusable graphics, including:



* Animated golf scorecards displayed during swings

* Full leaderboards at the conclusion of each hole

* Player and team introduction graphics

* Weekly league standings

* Hole transitions and matchup graphics

* Playoff brackets and championship animations

* Picture-in-picture GSPro gameplay overlays

* Sponsor-branded graphics and replay segments



We want graphics with a polished sports-broadcast feel similar to the Internet Invitational.



Sponsor Integrations



The series will feature recurring sponsor placements, including:



* Shot of the Week

* Choke of the Week

* Official Scorecard Sponsor

* Par 3 Sponsor

* League / Championship Sponsor

* Major-Week Giveaways

* Food Sponsor

* Slice of the Week



You’ll be responsible for incorporating sponsor logos, animations, replay graphics, and promotional segments into the episodes.



Short-Form Video Editing



Produce 10 short-form videos from each episode.



Each Short should:



* Be approximately 60–90 seconds

* Be formatted vertically (9:16)

* Include engaging hooks and professional captions

* Feature dynamic editing, zoom-ins, and sound effects where appropriate

* Highlight funny moments, golf shots, reactions, and rivalries

* Be ready for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and TikTok



We want someone who understands what makes short-form content entertaining and shareable.



Audio & Video Enhancement



* Professional color correction and grading

* Consistent color matching between cameras

* Dialogue enhancement and noise reduction

* Audio leveling and mixing

* Background music and sound effects

* Final mastering for YouTube



Our filming location has a dark, luxury speakeasy atmosphere. We want to preserve that aesthetic while maintaining clear, professional-looking footage.



Required Skills



* Advanced experience with Adobe Premiere Pro

* Strong experience with Adobe After Effects

* Professional YouTube video editing

* Motion graphics and animation

* Multicamera editing and synchronization

* Audio enhancement and mixing

* Color grading

* Short-form video editing

* Strong storytelling and comedic timing

* Ability to meet weekly deadlines

* Good written English communication



Experience editing golf, sports, gaming, or entertainment YouTube channels is a major advantage.



Important: Editable Project Files Required



We have in-house editors who may need to make changes to episodes, graphics, or sponsor placements.



For this reason, we require:



* Fully editable Premiere Pro project files

* After Effects files and reusable graphics templates

* Organized timelines and project folders

* Linked media and supporting assets

* Editable scorecards, leaderboards, and sponsor graphics

* Complete project handoff with each finished episode



We must be able to open and revise the projects independently.



Please do not apply if you can only provide finished MP4 exports.



Compensation & Project Structure



This is a paid, project-based opportunity, not an immediate full-time position.



We’re looking to hire someone for the first 10-episode season, with the possibility of ongoing work if the series performs well.



We’re open to negotiating a fair project rate based on experience, portfolio quality, and the full scope of work.



The entire season is 10 weeks and here is what we will need accomplished:



1. One complete pilot episode (40–60 minutes)

2. A package of 10 long-form episodes

3. A package of 100 short-form videos

4. Initial graphics and animation template development



We prefer to work with one editor or a small editing team that can handle both long-form and short-form production.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Portfolio



Share links to your best YouTube editing projects. Golf, sports, comedy, and entertainment content are especially relevant.



2. Motion Graphics Examples



Show examples of animated scoreboards, sports graphics, leaderboards, or similar projects you’ve created.



3. Software Experience

title: AI Video Editor For 8 Figure E-commerce Brand
description:
The Role



We're looking for a DTC AI Video Editor with proven experience working with 7-, 8- or 9-figure e-commerce brands.



You need to understand direct response, not just editing.



Our creative strategists will provide the script, angle and brief — roughly 50% of the ad. Your job is to own the other 50%:



- Choose the strongest footage from our B-roll library.

- Identify where the concept needs stronger or more specific visuals.

- Generate new AI content when existing footage isn't good enough.

- Make every visual congruent with the script, hook and emotional beat.

- Edit for attention, clarity, retention and conversion.

- Proactively improve the visual concept rather than simply executing instructions.



The goal isn't to make videos that look good. The goal is to make ads that perform.



What You'll Own



You'll be responsible for producing a minimum of 12–15 finished concepts per week, with some concepts requiring original AI content generation.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form DTC direct-response ads across multiple formats.

- Translating scripts and briefs into strong visual narratives.

- Selecting B-roll based on the psychology and intent of each line.

- Generating missing visuals using AI rather than settling for weak footage.

- Creating high-quality AI UGC, animation and other AI-native creative formats.

- Using tools/models such as Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling to a professional standard.

- Building strong hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing and visual escalation.

- Maintaining script-to-visual congruence throughout every creative.

- Finding ways to increase viewer retention without distracting from the sales message.

- Bringing new visual ideas to the creative strategists.

- Learning from winning and losing ads and improving future execution accordingly.

- Taking ownership of the finished creative rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.



Who We're Looking For



Non-negotiables



- Proven video-editing experience with successful DTC/e-commerce brands, ideally at 7-, 8- or 9-figure scale.

- Strong knowledge of direct-response advertising fundamentals.

- A portfolio demonstrating performance-focused paid social creative — not only polished brand content.

- High-level AI content generation ability.

- Hands-on experience with modern AI video workflows, ideally including Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling.

- Ability to create convincing AI UGC, animation and other visual formats.

- Strong instinct for matching visuals to copy.

- Understanding of hooks, pacing, pattern interrupts, curiosity, emotion, proof and retention.

- Ability to work at volume without allowing quality to collapse.

- Comfortable receiving a brief and independently solving visual problems.



The mindset



We're looking for someone who is:



- Obsessed with getting better.

- Extremely motivated.

- Proactive rather than reactive.

- Comfortable taking ownership.

- Curious about why an ad works, not merely how it was edited.

- Hungry to become an elite direct-response marketer, not just an editor.

- Excited by a fast-moving environment where standards continue to rise.



If you need every visual decision mapped out for you before you can start editing, this isn't the right role.



What Great Looks Like



A great editor on our team doesn't read a line in a script and ask:



> "What clip should I put here?"

> 



They ask:



> "What does the viewer need to see here for this line to hit as hard as possible?"

> 



If the right clip exists in the B-roll folder, use it.



If it doesn't, create it.



If the brief can be made stronger visually, say so and improve it.



You should be thinking about:



- What stops the scroll?

- Does the first visual strengthen the hook?

- Is every shot supporting what the voiceover is saying?

- Where could attention drop?

- Can this claim be demonstrated instead of stated?

- Is there a stronger visual proof?

- Does the edit build desire, belief or curiosity with every beat?

- What could we generate that would make this concept substantially stronger?



AI Capability



AI generation is a core part of this role — not an optional extra.



You should be comfortable generating production-ready creative across formats such as:



- AI UGC

- Character-led scenes

- Product-integrated scenes

- Cinematic B-roll

- Animations

- Visual metaphors

- Scroll-stopping hook visuals

- Scenes that would be difficult or expensive to shoot traditionally



We want to see real examples of your AI work and understand which tools/models you used to produce them.



Output & Working Rhythm



- Minimum 12–15 concepts per week.

- Mix of traditional editing and AI-assisted/generated concepts.

- Fast iteration based on creative feedback and performance learnings.

- Consistent communication with our creative strategists.

- High standards for both speed and execution.



We care about output, but volume without quality is not the goal. We want someone capable of building a repeatable workflow that delivers both.



Growth Opportunity



This is intended to be a long-term position.



For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to grow into:



- Lead Video Editor, taking ownership of editing standards and potentially helping develop other editors.

- Creative Strategist, if you develop strong enough direct-response, research and concepting ability.



We'll actively coach and train you in direct response while you work with us. We want someone who wants to compound their skill set and become a significantly stronger marketer over time.



Team Environment



You'll be joining a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand with a highly driven team.



We're ambitious about where we're taking the brand, and creative is one of the most important growth levers in the business.



That means this role comes with real ownership and real expectations.



Only apply if you're genuinely excited by a fast-moving, high-performance environment and want to take responsibility for an area that directly impacts the growth of the company.



Application Process



Start your application with the word “STRATEGIST”



If your application doesn't begin with that word, we'll assume you haven't read the full brief.



Then include:



- A short introduction and the DTC brands you've worked with.

- Links to your 3–5 strongest direct-response ads.

- Links to your best AI-generated video work.

- The AI tools/models you currently use and what you use each for.

- A brief explanation of your goals/vision for role development over the next 1-2 years.

description:
School Liaison & Visits Coordinator

ED-SG · [Remote / Singapore / Dubai] · [Full-time / Part-time / Independent contractor]

Reports to: [Bronwyn Small, Founder & CEO]



About ED-SG

ED-SG helps families relocating internationally find the right-fit international school. We work across Asia and the Gulf, with Singapore and Dubai at the centre of what we do.



We charge families directly and take no commissions from schools, so our guidance stays independent. Our work depends on strong, trusted relationships with the schools themselves.



The role

You will be the main point of contact between ED-SG and the international schools we work with.



When a family is weighing up schools, you make the visits happen. You check availability, book the tours, plan the route between campuses, and make sure parents arrive at the right place, at the right time, with the right information.



You will also build a working knowledge of each school’s programmes, so our consultants can give families accurate, current answers.



What you will do

School communication



Act as ED-SG’s primary contact with admissions teams at international schools in Singapore, Dubai and the other markets we serve

Request and confirm tour slots, open days, assessment dates and meetings with admissions staff

Find out specific programme information when a family needs it: curricula (IB, A-Levels, IGCSE, AP, US), learning support, language programmes, co-curricular activities, class sizes, waitlists and intake dates

Keep school contacts and correspondence up to date in our CRM (HubSpot)

Build and maintain professional, positive relationships with admissions teams

Scheduling and logistics



Build school visit itineraries for families, often three to five schools in a single day

Plan realistic timings that account for travel between campuses, traffic and buffer time

Coordinate across time zones, since parents are often still overseas when visits are booked

Send clear confirmations to consultants and families, and handle changes and cancellations quickly

Keep a shared calendar of all upcoming visits accurate and current

Programme knowledge



Learn the curricula and programmes offered at the schools we work with, and keep that knowledge current

Spot changes such as new programmes, fee updates or revised intake dates, and flag them to the consultant team

Help maintain our school profiles so the whole team works from accurate information

What you will bring

At least [two] years’ experience in a coordination, scheduling, admissions, executive assistant or client-service role

Excellent organisation: you are comfortable managing many moving parts, deadlines and people at once

Clear, professional written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail: dates, times, names and addresses are always right

A genuine appetite to learn, as you will become fluent in international curricula over time

Comfort working across Singapore (GMT+8) and Dubai (GMT+4) hours

Confidence with shared calendars,
 and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365

Nice to have



Experience in international education, school admissions or relocation services

Local knowledge of Singapore or Dubai: the geography, traffic patterns and school landscape

Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM

Additional languages, for example Mandarin, Arabic, Japanese or Korean
