title: Experienced - US Life Insurance - Appointment Setter | $5/hr + Bonus
description:
WHO WE ARE

Shiners Financial is a U.S. life insurance agency that helps families get covered. We want ambitious setters who stay with us for years and book appointments people actually show up to.



THE JOB

You'll call U.S. leads who asked about life insurance, get them on the calendar with our licensed agent, and make sure they're there when the agent calls.



Booking is the whole job. Pricing, products, and coverage questions all go to the agent.



Honestly, this position is driven by your work ethic. Most people you call won't book. Some will hang up on you. If you've done U.S. outbound calling before, you already know that. If you haven't, this probably isn't the job for you.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Dialing leads inside our CRM (lists, time zones, and the dialer are already set up)

- Putting appointments on the agent's calendar

- Reminding people about their appointment so they show up

- Calling back leads who haven't booked yet

- Noting down what happened on every call

- Sending a short recap when your shift ends



PAY AND HOURS

- $5.00 USD an hour (around $1,040 a month)

- $3 extra for every appointment that shows up

- Room to increase your rate based on performance

- Paid twice a month

- Monday to Saturday, 8 hours a day

- 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern

  That's 10:00 PM - 6:00 AM Manila from November to March,

  and 9:00 PM - 5:00 AM Manila from March to November

- Full-time and long-term



If you're good at this and you stick around, there's room to move into training and hiring new setters as we grow.



WHAT YOU NEED

- 2+ years making outbound calls to U.S. customers (setting appointments, telemarketing, or sales)

- Fluent English with a clear, easy-to-understand accent (U.S. callers should understand you the first time)

- Your own laptop or desktop, Core i5 or better with 8GB RAM. Phones and tablets won't work.

- 25 Mbps or faster internet, and a second connection ready if it drops

- A way to keep working when the power goes out

- A noise-canceling USB headset and a quiet room

- No other job during our hours

- A working webcam & able to get on a Zoom call with your camera on (if needed)



NICE TO HAVE

- Final expense or mortgage protection calling experience

- Time on a dialer or CRM (GoHighLevel, Ringy, ReadyMode, etc)

- You've worked U.S. night shift before



YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU

- Want to stay somewhere long-term instead of hopping jobs

- Can hear "no" all day and still sound good on the next call

- Like getting paid more when your appointments show up

- Are open to coaching and following a script



HOW HIRING WORKS

1. We go through applications and watch every video

2. You do a few paid trial shifts on real leads

3. If it's a fit, we make you a full-time offer



HOW TO APPLY

If you skip any of these steps, we won't review your application.



1. Start your application with the word LEGACY.



2. Send us a short video, 3 minutes or less, with your camera on. Record it where you'd actually work, with the headset you'd use. Upload it to Loom, YouTube (unlisted), or Google Drive and paste the link. Make sure we can open it. If you're not sure how to do any of this, figuring it out is part of the test.



In the video:

- Introduce yourself

- Tell us about your appointment setting experience, especially life insurance

- Tell us which dialers, CRMs, or other systems you've used

- Tell us how many appointments you usually set per day or per week, and your show rate if you know it

- Read this like it's a real call:



"Hi, is this Mary? Hi Mary, this is [your name] calling about the life insurance information you asked for. I'll be quick. I just want to set up a short call with our licensed agent so they can go over your options. Would tomorrow at 2 PM or Thursday at 10 AM work better for you?"



- Then pretend Mary says: "Just send me something in the mail." Show us what you'd say next. No script for this part.



3. In the message you send with your application, answer these:

- Can you work this shift, Monday to Saturday, for at least a year?

- Do you have another job right now?

- What do you do if the power or internet goes out?

- Run a speed test at speedtest.net and paste the link to your result

title: Remote Operations & Delivery Manager
description:
We're an Australian business group behind Fore Fun Golf Club, an entertainment venue, and Brewy Superfoods, a superfood coffee brand. We're hiring a Philippines-based Operations & Delivery Manager to turn priorities into finished work across both businesses.



This is a long-term, remote, part-time independent contractor role. You'll work alongside our marketing and operations lead, coordinating people, deadlines and handoffs without the founder having to chase every step.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



• Turn business priorities into practical plans with clear owners, deadlines and dependencies.

• Keep projects moving across marketing, creative, suppliers and operations.

• Follow up before deadlines slip, resolve routine blockers and escalate decisions with a recommendation.

• Keep ClickUp accurate so the team knows what happens next.

• Improve recurring processes instead of repeatedly fixing the same problem.

• Give short, useful updates: what's done, what's blocked and what needs a decision.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• 3+ years coordinating projects or business operations.

• Evidence of personally moving work across several people from brief to completion.

• Strong written English and confident, respectful follow-up.

• Hands-on experience setting up and running a project-management tool, ideally ClickUp.

• Good judgment when priorities conflict or capacity is limited.

• Reliable internet, suitable equipment and a practical backup plan for outages.



You don't need to know every tool we use. You do need to learn independently, spot missing steps and take responsibility for getting work finished.

title: Recruitment Specialist /WFH
description:
We are a human resources service agency looking for a professional and experienced recruitment specialist to join our human resources team.

The ideal candidate will primarily be responsible for end-to-end recruitment and operations, focusing on large-scale talent recruitment and supporting the continuous talent supply and team expansion of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) business.

You will collaborate with various business departments to efficiently achieve recruitment goals and optimize the overall recruitment process.



Key Responsibilities

-Independently undertake the full cycle recruitment work for BPO positions, including talent search, resume screening, interview scheduling, candidate evaluation, salary negotiation, and follow-up after onboarding.

-Ensure timely completion of recruitment key performance indicators (KPIs)

-Real time tracking of candidate status, resolving issues and doubts during the recruitment process, improving candidate experience and hiring rate.

-Assist in optimizing the recruitment process and implementing recruitment system improvements based on business development needs.



Job Requirements

-Fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, writing): able to proficiently use English for daily work communication, candidate interviews, business communication, and document writing.

-Having extensive recruitment experience in the BPO industry (call center, customer service, operations, and related positions), familiar with the job characteristics, talent market, and recruitment pain points of the industry.

-Having excellent communication and interpersonal skills, proficient in cross departmental communication and negotiating with candidates, possessing strong empathy and service awareness.

-Proficient in using OFFICE software and online video tools(Teams/Zoom).

-Clear logical thinking, meticulous and rigorous work, skilled in summarizing and optimizing recruitment methods to improve work efficiency.

-Priority will be given to candidates with relevant experience in human resources recruitment; Candidates with local business process outsourcing (BPO) recruitment resources in the Philippines will be given priority consideration.



Salary & Benefits
peso base pay per month+bonus



Why join us?

-Competitive salary and performance bonus plan

-Opportunities for Long term Stable Development of Overseas Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Industry



Please send:?

1. Your resume

2. Your recruitment experience

3. Your expected monthly salary

4. The word “RS” in the subject line so we know you read the full post?

We are looking for someone who wants a long-term career and is ready to grow with our company.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM) - $900 p/m + Bonuses (Up to $1,400 p/m)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



IMPORTANT NOTE: This position is currently full, but new spots can open at any time as our team grows. We're still accepting applications and interviewing qualified candidates for our waitlist. If you're a good fit, you'll be among the first people we reach out to when a spot opens!



This role is for a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



This is an independent contractor role, not an employee position. You'll work under an independent contractor agreement.



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Base pay: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050-$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30-$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20-25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30-45 minutes. Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form:

In the Name field write: "TOM" + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Pay: $1,200 fixed monthly base + up to $500 monthly performance bonus ($1,700 total monthly potential before separate revenue bonuses)



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher: 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 team members around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Independent contractor role: Minimum 37.5 hours a week, Monday to Friday

- Shift schedule: Based on team coverage. Some CFMs work ET morning to afternoon, others ET afternoon to evening.

- Regular pay: Long-term role with on-time payments

- Supportive team: Collaborative environment without micromanagement

- Growth path: Opportunities to increase responsibilities and earnings

- 100% remote: Work-from-home setup



TASKS



Content & Client Feedback



- Review 50-100 short-form client videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) per day in our Slack feedback channel before they are published

- Give constructive, actionable feedback on hooks (verbal/headline/visual), scripting, pacing, editing, and CTA, making sure each client knows exactly how to improve

- Cross-reference each piece of content with client niche, experience, and goals as outlined in their files

- Review previous feedback to ensure consistency and avoid contradictions

- Quality-control content ideas created by our Content Research Experts before delivery to the client, ensuring fit with niche, experience, and likely performance

- Oversee workload balance among Content Research Experts and make sure no one on the team is overloaded or underutilized

- Respond to client questions or tech issues in Slack within 24 hours

- Be tough but fair. Only approve content that meets quality standards.



Progress Tracking



- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Join the weekly CFM team call (Tuesdays, 7am ET)

- Keep internal feedback and client progress records up to date



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.

- Great Work-Life Balance: Monday to Friday only, no weekend work.

- Professional Growth: Accelerate your skill set through regular feedback and advanced training.

title: Technical ONBOARDING MANAGER
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



IMPORTANT NOTE: This position is currently full, but new spots can open at any time as our team grows. We're still accepting applications and interviewing qualified candidates for our waitlist. If you're a good fit, you'll be among the first people we reach out to when a spot opens!



This role is for a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



This is an independent contractor role, not an employee position. You'll work under an independent contractor agreement.



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Base pay: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050-$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30-$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20-25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30-45 minutes. Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

title: Remote Sales, Marketing & Administrative Assistant – Aesthetic Clinic (Ireland)
description:
Remote Sales, Marketing & Administrative Assistant

Company : Bally Bliss Clinic & Spa  

Location: Ireland (Fully Remote – Philippines)  

**Employment Type:** Part-Time initially, with potential for long-term employment  

**Working Hours:** 20–25 hours per week  starting , can be upgraded to full time based on performance in sales.

**Base Salary:** US$400–500 per month, depending on experience  , negotiable

**Additional Compensation:** Performance-based sales commission and incentives



---



## 1. About Bally Bliss Clinic & Spa



Bally Bliss Clinic & Spa is an aesthetic, beauty and wellness clinic based in Ireland, offering a range of professional skincare, beauty, wellness and medical aesthetic treatments.



We are looking for a motivated, creative, organised and commercially minded Remote Sales, Marketing & Administrative Assistant to join our growing team.



This is a multi-functional role combining sales, customer service, digital marketing, content creation and administrative support.



The successful candidate will play an important role in generating revenue, converting potential customers into paying clients, promoting our treatments and products, maintaining customer relationships and supporting the daily operations of the clinic.



We are looking for someone who takes initiative, communicates confidently, enjoys selling and can work independently in a remote environment.



## 2. Key Responsibilities



### A. Sales & Lead Conversion



The primary responsibility is to convert potential customers into paying clients and generate revenue for the clinic.



Responsibilities include:



- Follow up all prospective customers and leads generated through
 and Instagram (Meta Ads).

- Respond promptly and professionally to enquiries through WhatsApp Business,
 Messenger and Instagram Direct Messages.

- Contact prospective customers through messaging and telephone calls where appropriate.

- Follow up customers who have expressed interest but have not yet booked an appointment.

- Convert enquiries into confirmed appointments and paying customers.

- Understand customer needs and recommend suitable treatments using clinic-approved information.

- Maintain consistent communication with potential customers throughout the sales journey.

- Follow up outstanding enquiries and maintain an organised lead pipeline.

- Identify reasons why potential customers do not proceed with bookings and report feedback to management.

- Achieve agreed monthly sales and customer conversion targets.



### B. Upselling & Revenue Generation



Help increase the clinic's revenue by promoting additional services, products and treatment packages.



Responsibilities include:



- Promote and upsell the clinic's aesthetic treatments, beauty services and skincare products.

- Recommend appropriate treatment packages, memberships and promotional offers using approved clinic information.

- Identify opportunities to increase the value of customer bookings through suitable additional services.

- Encourage existing customers to return for repeat treatments.

- Follow up previous customers to promote relevant treatments and rebooking opportunities.

- Introduce promotional campaigns and seasonal offers to prospective and existing customers.

- Maintain knowledge of the clinic's treatment menu, prices, promotions and products.

- Achieve agreed upselling and revenue targets.



### C. Social Media Marketing & Content Creation



Assist with the clinic's digital marketing and social media presence to increase brand awareness, engagement and customer enquiries.



Responsibilities include:



- Create engaging marketing content for Instagram and
.

- Design promotional graphics, treatment advertisements and educational posts using Canva.

- Create and edit short-form videos, Instagram Reels and promotional videos using CapCut or similar applications.

- Write engaging captions, promotional messages and marketing copy.

- Develop and maintain a monthly social media content calendar.

- Schedule and publish approved content consistently.

- Repurpose existing clinic photographs, videos and marketing materials into new content.

- Create content promoting treatments, skincare products, clinic services and special offers.

- Assist with promotional campaigns, seasonal marketing and product launches.

- Monitor social media engagement and provide suggestions to improve content performance.

- Coordinate with the clinic's Meta Ads manager to ensure content aligns with advertising campaigns.

- Maintain a consistent, professional and premium brand image across social media platforms.



### D. Appointment & Booking Administration



Manage appointment-related administration to ensure a smooth customer experience.



Responsibilities include:



- Schedule appointments for new customers.

- Reschedule, rearrange and confirm existing appointments.

- Manage appointment cancellations and changes.

- Follow up customers who have missed appointments.

- Coordinate appointment availability with clinic staff.

- Send appointment confirmations and reminders.

- Follow up customers who have not completed their booking or deposit payment.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date booking records.

- Assist customers with general booking enquiries.



### E. Remote Administrative & Operational Support



Provide general administrative support to ensure the clinic operates efficiently.



Responsibilities include:



- Manage daily customer communications and enquiries.

- Update customer information and sales records in the clinic's booking system or CRM.

- Maintain an organised database of leads and prospective customers.

- Track sales conversions, revenue and customer follow-up activities.

- Prepare daily and weekly sales performance reports.

- Monitor outstanding customer enquiries and follow-up tasks.

- Assist with organising promotional campaigns and marketing activities.

- Coordinate with clinic management and relevant team members.

- Perform other reasonable administrative duties related to the role.



## 3. Required Qualifications & Skills



The ideal candidate should possess:



- At least 2 years of experience in sales, customer service, digital marketing, administration or virtual assistance.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong communication, negotiation and persuasion skills.

- Confidence in converting customer enquiries into sales.

- Experience following up prospective customers and managing sales leads.

- Good understanding of customer service and relationship management.

- Experience using WhatsApp Business,
 and Instagram.

- Good knowledge of Canva for graphic design and marketing materials.

- Basic video editing skills using CapCut or similar software.

- Good organisational and time-management skills.

- Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable work-from-home environment.

- Willingness to work during agreed Irish business hours.



## 4. Preferred Experience



Candidates with the following experience will have an advantage:



- Previous employment in aesthetic clinics, beauty salons, dermatology clinics, medical spas or wellness businesses.

- Experience handling leads generated through
 and Instagram advertising.

- Experience in telesales, appointment setting or sales conversion.

- Experience promoting skincare products, beauty treatments or treatment packages.

- Familiarity with CRM and appointment booking systems.

- Experience using Zenoti booking software is a plus 

- Experience with social media scheduling and marketing analytics.

- Experience working with international clients or overseas businesses.



## 5. Salary & Commission Structure



We offer a fixed monthly base salary together with additional performance-based sales commission.



**Fixed Base Salary:**

- US$400–500 per month, depending on experience, qualifications and working hours, negotiable



**Additional Sales Commission:**



The successful candidate will have opportunities to earn additional commission based on qualifying sales generated through:



- Conversion of assigned prospective customer enquiries.

- Follow-up and successful conversion of Meta Ads leads.

- Upselling of treatments, services and skincare products.

- Reactivation of previous customers and generation of repeat business.



Commission will be calculated on qualifying sales revenue actually received by the clinic, subject to agreed attribution rules and commission terms.



The commission rate, eligibility criteria, payment arrangements and sales targets will be agreed in writing before employment begins.



Additional performance incentives may be offered for achieving or exceeding monthly sales targets.



## 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be reviewed regularly based on measurable results.



**Sales & Customer Conversion**

- Number of prospective customers contacted and followed up.

- Response time to new enquiries.

- Lead-to-booking conversion rate.

- Revenue generated from converted leads.

- Number of successful upsells.

- Number of repeat bookings and reactivated customers.

- Achievement of monthly sales targets.



**Marketing & Content Creation**

- Number and quality of social media posts produced.

- Number of Reels and short-form videos created.

- Consistency of content publication.

- Completion of the monthly content calendar.

- Social media engagement and audience growth.

- Quality and effectiveness of promotional materials.



**Administration & Customer Service**

- Accuracy of customer and booking records.

- Timely appointment confirmations and rescheduling.

- Quality of customer communication.

- Completion of follow-up activities.

- Accuracy and timeliness of daily and weekly reports.



## 7. Working Arrangement



- Fully remote, work-from-home position.

- Part-time initially, approximately 20–25 hours per week.

- Must be available during mutually agreed working hours aligned with Irish business hours.

- Fixed monthly salary plus performance-based commission.

- Initial paid trial period of 30 days.

- Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.

- Regular communication and reporting to clinic management.



## 8. Important Responsibilities & Professional Standards



- Maintain confidentiality of all clinic and customer information.

- Follow the clinic's approved customer service procedures and marketing guidelines.

- Do not independently provide medical advice, diagnose conditions or recommend treatments beyond approved information.

- Refer clinical questions and treatment suitability concerns to authorised clinical personnel.

- Do not publish medical claims, treatment guarantees or before-and-after photographs without appropriate approval.

- Use customer information only for authorised business purposes.

- Follow applicable privacy and data protection requirements.



## 9. Application Requirements



Interested candidates should submit the following:



1. Updated CV highlighting relevant work experience.

2. A brief introduction explaining why they are suitable for this role.

3. Details of previous sales, customer service or virtual assistant experience.

4. Examples of social media posts, promotional graphics or Reels they have created.

5. A list of software and platforms they have experience using, including Canva, CapCut, WhatsApp Business and CRM systems.

6. Previous experience converting enquiries into paying customers, with examples where possible.

7. Expected monthly salary.

8. Availability to work during Irish business hours.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a practical assessment involving a simulated sales enquiry, a social media content task and an appointment administration exercise.



---



## 10. What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is not simply an administrative assistant, but someone who can contribute directly to the growth of our business.



The ideal candidate is:



- Sales-oriented and confident in converting enquiries into bookings.

- Creative and capable of producing engaging social media content.

- Organised and reliable in managing appointments and administrative tasks.

- Proactive in following up customers and identifying sales opportunities.

- Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for assigned tasks.

- Motivated by achieving targets and earning performance-based commission.



**If you are passionate about sales, digital marketing, customer service and working with a growing aesthetic and wellness clinic, we would love to hear from you.**



**Join Bally Bliss Clinic & Spa and become part of our growing remote team!**

title: Title: Sales Operations Coordinator (GoHighLevel) | Full-Time | UK Hours
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



We're a fast-moving, ambitious UK-based property education and mentoring business supporting property investors. We're good to work with, and people who love it here stay for years.



Our sales team runs appointment setting, discovery calls and webinars. This role sits at the center of keeping that engine clean, accurate and well reported.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a key role in the business, and it's for someone who leans into doing a great job and likes being busy. It's fast-paced, so you'll need to get up to speed quickly and be comfortable handling a full workload from early on.



This is a sales operations role, not a general admin or EA role. You'll work directly with the sales team: the appointment setters and the call closers.



Your main job is to keep the CRM clean. Every lead that reaches a setter should be complete, accurate and ready to call. You'll know what good data looks like, spot what's missing or wrong, and fix it before it slows anyone down.



You won't be building automations. They're already set up, so you'll use what's in place and focus on keeping the pipeline healthy.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Own the GoHighLevel pipelines: keep opportunities in the right stages, lead statuses correct, and duplicates and missing data cleaned up

• Make sure every lead passed to the setters is clean, complete and ready to call

• Run regular pipeline check-ins and clean-ups so nothing stalls unnoticed

• Build and send weekly sales performance reports covering calls, connects, bookings, attendance and conversion

• Track and verify commission numbers each cycle and prepare them for sign-off

• Spot gaps in setter and closer activity from the data and raise them early

• Keep trackers and documentation current so the team works from one version of the truth

• Support webinars and events on the operational side, plus light recruitment and onboarding admin for new sales hires



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Hands-on GoHighLevel experience (required), especially managing pipelines and opportunities day to day

• Strong CRM data management: you know what clean, complete lead data looks like and how to keep it that way

• Confident in Google Sheets and Excel: you can build and maintain trackers and reports, not just update ones someone else made

• Comfortable handling figures that affect what people get paid, with a clear process for checking your own accuracy

• Someone who leans into doing a great job, enjoys being busy and wants a key role in a growing business

• Proactive and one step ahead: you ask questions, raise issues early and don't wait to be told what's broken

• Able to get up to speed quickly in a fast-moving environment

• Experience working inside or alongside a sales team, ideally with appointment setters or sales reps

• Strong written English and the confidence to raise an issue with a senior stakeholder

• Organized, independent, and able to run your own week without close supervision

• Reliable home setup: own computer, stable internet, backup power and internet, and a quiet dedicated workspace



NICE TO HAVE



• Experience in property, real estate, coaching or education

• Exposure to commission or incentive tracking

• Experience supporting webinars or live events



SCHEDULE AND TERMS



• Full-time, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM UK time (7:00 PM to 4:00 AM Manila time)

• Rate: £4 per hour during the 3-month probation, £5 per hour after

• Paid monthly

• Time tracked via Time Doctor

• Long-term role, remote, independent contractor basis

• This needs to be your only job during these hours

title: Full-Cycle Acquisitions Closer — US RE Wholesaling | Leads + Playbook Provided | US$8/hr + 10% of Assignment Fee
description:
This is a talk-time job. If you love being on the phone with US homeowners and investors, and you have the locked contracts to prove it, keep reading. If you need training, this is not your seat.



**Who we are**

A virtual real estate wholesaling operation. We put motivated sellers' houses under contract in US markets and assign those contracts to cash buyers. Assignment fees target US$10,000+. We only operate where we're cleared to: Oklahoma, Illinois and the City of Philadelphia are excluded, along with any other market we choose to exclude.



**The role: full cycle, first call to funding**

You run the deal end to end: call the seller, find the real reason they're selling, present the offer, handle objections, get the contract signed, line up the cash buyer, and quarterback it with title until it funds. The owner signs off on the key decisions (listed below). Everything else is yours.



**Why this seat is different**

- Leads arrive stacked from public distress data (tax-delinquent, code-violation, probate/estate) plus FSBO sellers.

- Every lead is pre-underwritten: ARV from sold comps, a repair estimate, and your offer band (opening offer, target, hard ceiling) on a deal sheet.

- A written closer playbook (call script, motivation questions, objection handling, follow-up cadence, closing checklists) is provided on day one.

- Our cash-buyer list is being built in each target market, and you'll help grow it.



**What you own**

- Seller calls: cold open, rapport, motivation, a below-ask cash offer, objections, verbal agreement.

- Sending our approved contract to the seller for signature once the owner approves the offer.

- Dispositions: building and maintaining our cash-buyer list per market (recent cash buyers, their criteria, how fast they close), marketing locked deals and collecting buyer offers.

- Closing coordination: documents, signatures and updates between seller, buyer and title until funding.

- Same-day CRM logging on every lead and buyer. Short pipeline report every Friday.



**What the owner approves, every time**

1. Any offer above the hard ceiling on the deal sheet.

2. Every contract before it's sent. You never sign on the company's behalf.

3. All money. You never handle earnest money, wires or wire instructions.

4. The final buyer and the assignment fee.

5. The title company we use.



**The daily standard**

- Cold lists: 120+ dials a day. Warm FSBO days: 50+ dials.

- 3+ hours of real talk time, 12+ live seller conversations a day.

- Offers presented daily: 3 on FSBO days, 1–2 on cold-list days.

- A 30-day follow-up cadence on every worked lead. Most contracts come from follow-ups, not first calls.

- 25+ active cash buyers with known criteria per target market within your first 30 days.

- First signed contract targeted within 45 days. Activity and pipeline reviewed at 30 days.



**How we call**

Every call is made by a person. No AI dialers, no bots, no spam texts. Numbers are scrubbed against federal and state Do Not Call lists before dialing. Calls only inside each seller's local legal hours (never before 8 AM or after 8 PM their time, stricter where required). Opt-outs honoured instantly. No texting without written consent. You follow the playbook's compliance lines word for word: sellers are told we may assign the contract, and we never promise a closing date or price the owner hasn't approved. Calls are recorded. They protect your commission as much as they protect us.



**Required, all of it**

1. Fluent spoken and written English that US homeowners understand easily. We screen this first; weak English is an automatic no.

2. 2+ years calling US sellers for a wholesaling or acquisitions company. Dispositions experience is a strong plus.

3. Contracts you personally locked in the last 12 months, with proof (see application).

4. You can run the full seller call without reading from a script, while keeping the required compliance lines.

5. You know MAO, assignments, earnest money, title-company closings and what cash buyers pay for.

6. Daily CRM + power-dialer fluency (GoHighLevel, Podio, REsimpli, XLeads or similar). We provide logins; we don't train CRM basics.

7. Quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset, stable internet + backup connection.



**Schedule**

Full-time, Monday to Friday, 10 AM–6 PM US Eastern (40 hrs/week). That's overnight Philippines time, so only apply if that schedule genuinely works for you long-term.



**Pay, printed not hidden**

- US$8/hr full-time base + US$500 bonus per signed contract (US$250 paid at signing, US$250 paid at closing) + 10% of the assignment fee at closing, uncapped.

- Example: on a US$15,000 assignment fee, you earn US$1,500 (10%) plus the US$500 signed-contract bonus — US$2,000 in deal pay, in addition to your hourly base. These are examples, not a promise of earnings.

- You can see the closing statement on each of your deals to verify your commission.

- Pay lands the same day every cycle, your hours are protected (no off-shift expectations), and feedback runs both ways. Firm standards, straight dealing.



**How to apply (incomplete applications are deleted unread)**

Subject line: CLOSER | [# contracts locked in last 12 months] | [biggest assignment fee] | [Your Name]

Start your message with the word "MAO" so we know you read this far. Then include:

1. A 60-second voice recording: your cold open to a tax-delinquent homeowner in Ohio. Talk, don't read.

2. Written answers:

a. How many wholesale contracts have you personally locked in the last 12 months?

b. Your biggest assignment fee, and your exact role in that deal?

c. Have you sold deals to cash buyers yourself? How many, and how did you find the buyers?

d. Which CRM and dialer have you used most, and for how long?

3. Proof: a recorded seller call (seller details removed) OR a redacted signed purchase contract you locked, plus one reference we can call.



**Next step**

Shortlisted candidates do a paid, recorded live-call trial on approved leads at the same hourly rate plus commission. The trial is the interview.

title: Ilocano Curriculum Specialist / Ilocano Coach
description:
Tahanan (
) is a language-learning app that teaches Tagalog and Bisaya to learners around the world through bite-sized lessons, flashcards, AI speaking practice, and feedback from real coaches. We're launching Ilocano next, and we're looking for a native Ilocano speaker to help us build it.



What you'll do

- Translate our full Tagalog curriculum (lessons, example sentences, vocabulary, and flashcards) into natural, everyday Ilocano.

- Work in Google Docs. Each lesson comes prepared with the Tagalog source and an empty Ilocano column, so you can focus on translating, not formatting.

- Flag words or phrases that don't translate directly and suggest how a native speaker would actually say them.

- Keep a short glossary so terms stay consistent across lessons.



What we're looking for

- Native or near-native Ilocano speaker, fluent in Tagalog/Filipino and comfortable in English.

- Translation, localization, or proofreading experience.

- Careful with spelling, consistency, and tone. Learners will study every word you write.

- Reliable, full time, and able to share progress daily.



Optional (paid separately, tell us if you're interested)

- Voice recording: record Ilocano words and sentences for pronunciation audio.

- Coaching after launch: give learners written or voice feedback on their Ilocano recordings, paid per feedback.



Pay

- $3/hour, full time, paid monthly.

- Long-term work: after the translation, there's ongoing work in recording, review, and coaching as Ilocano grows.



How to apply

Send a short message in Ilocano and English introducing yourself, plus this sentence translated into Ilocano: "Good morning! Have you eaten yet? Let's study together today."

We are looking for a highly skilled packaging designer to create professional, premium-quality packaging for a physical consumer product.



We already have reference designs showcasing the exact visual direction we're looking for. We need someone who can refine these references and turn them into high-quality, manufacturing-ready packaging designs using Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.



What We Need



Design a professional retail packaging box.



Create a matching product label.



Develop a clean, premium, visually appealing design.



Ensure consistent branding, colors, typography, and graphics.



Create realistic 3D mockups of the finished packaging.



Prepare accurate print-ready files for manufacturing.



Requirements



Must use Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.



All packaging designs must be professionally created in Adobe software, not AI image generators or Canva.



Proven experience designing physical product packaging.



Strong portfolio showcasing premium retail packaging designs.



Experience working with packaging dielines, dimensions, bleed, and print specifications.



Exceptional attention to detail, typography, alignment, and visual consistency.



Ability to follow references while improving their overall quality.



Deliverables



Complete retail box packaging design.



Matching product label design.



Photorealistic 3D packaging mockups.



Fully editable Adobe Illustrator (.AI) and Photoshop (.PSD) source files, as applicable.



Print-ready files suitable for manufacturing.



Important



This project MUST be completed using Adobe software. We are NOT looking for AI-generated packaging designs, Canva templates, or flattened images.



We need an experienced graphic designer who understands professional packaging design and can create properly structured, fully editable Adobe files that can be sent directly to our manufacturer.



We will provide the necessary references, branding assets, product information, and dimensions.



To Apply



Please include:



Your portfolio showcasing previous packaging design work.



Examples of packaging that has actually been manufactured.



Confirmation that you work with Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.



Your estimated project cost.



Your expected turnaround time.



Only applicants with strong packaging design experience and professional Adobe skills will be considered.

title: Senior Estimator and sales support (remote)
description:
Remote | Philippines based | Australian company



Raven Engineering Group specialises in water storage tanks, engineering, installation, refurbishment and maintenance projects across Australia.



We’re looking for a highly organised estimator with excellent communication skills and exceptional attention to detail.



Your main responsibility will be preparing accurate quotations and budgets, clarifying project requirements and supporting our sales team. We need someone who works efficiently, asks the right questions and follows enquiries through without constant reminders.



You must be confident reviewing drawings and specifications, working with Excel and communicating professionally with Australian clients and suppliers.



Key responsibilities



• Prepare accurate, clearly presented quotations, cost estimates and project budgets using Excel.

• Review drawings, specifications, attachments and relevant
 correspondence before preparing a quote or requesting information.

• Complete material takeoffs and allow for labour, freight, travel, accommodation, equipment and subcontractors where requied.

• Identify missing or conflicting information and prepare clear, project specific RFIs. Avoid generic questions or asking clients for information they have already supplied.

• Obtain supplier pricing and confirm specifications, availability, lead times and quote validity.

• Clearl document the scope, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions behind each quotation.

• Check quantities, formulas, rates and margins before submitting quotations for approval.

• Manage multiple enquiries and quote revisions. Meet agreed turnaround times and flag delays before deadlines are missed.

• Maintain accurate pricing records, estimating spreadsheets and enquiry notes in our systems.

• Follow up with clients and suppliers and keep the sales team informed of progress.

• Prepare a clear handover of accepted quotations, including the budget, scope, commitments and outstanding items.



Communication and attention to detail



Strong communication is essential. You must be able to understand what a client needs, ask precise questions and write clear, natural
s.



• Read the full enquiry and supporting documents before responding.

• Tailor correspondence to the actual project.

• Respond promptly and make the next step clear.

• Be confident speaking with clients, suppliers and colleagues when a call will resolve something faster.

• Check names, dimensions, quantities, specifications, attachments and pricing before sending.

• Raise uncertainties rather than guessing or making unsupported commitments.



We need someone who can produce work that requires minimal correction. Speed matters, but quotations must remain accurate and complete.



Improve how we work



We want someone who improves our estimating processes as well as handles the daily workload.



This includes maintaining reliable costing templates, improving pricing records and reducing repetitive administration.



You should be confident using ChatGPT and other AI tools to review information, prepare correspondence and improve productivity. You must check AI output against the source documents and calculations before relying on it.



What we’re looking for



• Proven estimating or costing experience in construction, engineering, manufacturing or a similar industry.

• Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, lookup functions and the ability to build, check and maintain costing models.

• Exceptional attention to detail and consistent accuracy.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You must be articulate, professional and confident communicating with Australian client.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and project scopes.

• Strong commercial judgement when reviewing supplier pricing, costs, margins and exclusions.

• Fast, reliable turnaround and the ability to manage competing deadlines.

• Confidence using ChatGPT and other technology while applying your own judgement.

• Pipedrive and experience working with an Australian business are highly desirable.

• Initiative, accountability and consistent follow through.



You should not need repeated reminders to respond, follow up or complete a quotation.



About the role



This is a remote position working with our Australian team during agreed Australian business hours.



We will provide training on our products and estimating processes. You will need to bring strong estimating fundamentals, Excel skills and communication from the start.



Performance will be measured by quotation accuracy, turnaround times, clear communication and reliable follow through.



There is an opportunity to grow into a broader estimating and sales role as you develop your understanding of the business.



How to apply



Send a one minute introductory video and your CV directly to WhatsApp:




Record and send your video directly in the WhatsApp chat. Only videos playable within the chat will be viewed. Do not send Google Drive links, cloud storage links or links to download your video.



In your video, briefly explain:



• Your estimating or relevant costing experience.

• Your Excel skills and the types of costing spreadsheets you have used.

• How you check your work while meeting tight deadlines.

• One practical example of how you have used AI or automation.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same WhatsApp chat. Include your expected monthly salary in USD, earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical exercise covering costing, attention to detail and client communication.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

title: Project manager and QA coordinator (Remote)
description:
Remote | Philippines based | Australian company | Immediate start



Raven Engineering Group specialises in water storage tanks, engineering, installation, refurbishment and maintenance projects across Australia.



We’re looking for an organised, confident project manager to take ownership of our projects from sales handover through to completion and final payment.



We typically have around 40 active projects at different stages. We need someone who keeps jobs moving, follows through and makes sure the required checks happen before work proceeds.



This is a remote coordination and management role. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must understand construction project delivery and be comfortable working with drawings, specifications and quality records.



You will work closely with our design, procurement, installation and accounts teams. You must be available during agreed Australian business hours to support our site crews and clients.



Pay and progression



Starting rate is USD $8 per hour, with the opportunity to progress to USD $10 to $12 per hour based on demonstrated performance and ownership.



Progression will depend on results, attention to detail and your ability to manage projects independently and improve how we work.



The position is available to start immediately.



Project management responsibilities



• Manage approximately 40 active projects at different stages, from sales handover through to completion and final payment.

• Maintain accurate project records, tasks, responsibilities and follow ups in Pipedrive and ServiceM8.

• Coordinate engineering, estimating, procurement, installation and accounts.

• Track schedules, manufacturing, deliveries, installation dates and deadlines.

• Follow up on drawing approvals, purchase orders, outstanding information and client decisions.

• Track budgets, costs, variations and payment milestones. Ensure changes are recorded and the required approvals are obtained.

• Coordinate invoicing with accounts and follow up on outstanding payments.

• Lead project meetings, assign actions and make sure agreed tasks are completed.

• Identify delays and problems early. Resolve what you can and escalate decisions with clear facts and proposed next steps.

• Provide concise progress updates showing priorities, overdue actions and decisions needed.



Quality assurance and project readiness



Your role includes making sure the right checks happen before materials are installed and before work is covered or crews leave site.



• Confirm site teams have the current approved drawings, scope, material requirements and checklists.

• Coordinate checks of delivered materials against approved specifications, including product codes, delivery records and certificates.

• Ensure material substitutions and changes to the approved design are referred to the responsible person for written approval before use.

• Maintain records of required licences, training, insurance, inductions and permits. Flag missing or expired documents before mobilisation.

• Coordinate required inspections and hold points. A hold point is a stage where work cannot proceed until the required check and approval are complete.

• Review daily site updates, photos and forms for completeness. Follow up on missing or unclear evidence promptly.

• Maintain a register of defects, departures from approved requirements and corrective actions, with an owner and due date for each item.

• Before crews leave site, confirm the responsible supervisor has checked the work and any remaining items have an agreed plan and approval.

• Organise completion records, warranties, handover documents and client sign offs.



You will have management support to hold mobilisation or affected work where required checks or approvals are missing.



Technical decisions and engineering certification remain with the responsible qualified people. Site supervisors remain responsible for checking physical materials and workmanship. Your responsibility is to make sure these checks happen, the evidence is recorded and outstanding items are closed.



Improve how we work



We want someone who spots recurring problems and introduces practical improvements.



This includes improving project handovers, material checks, checklists, reporting and document control.



You should be comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to help review information, prepare reports and identify gaps. You must check the output and know when an issue needs a person with technical expertise.



What we’re looking for



• Proven experience managing multiple projects in construction, engineering, manufacturing or a similar environment.

• Strong attention to detail and consistent follow through.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to Australian clients, suppliers and site teams.

• Confidence to lead meetings, ask direct questions and hold people accountable.

• The ability to read project drawings and specifications well enough to identify discrepancies and raise clear questions.

• Experience coordinating QA records, inspections, material approvals or project closeout.

• Strong organisation and the ability to prioritise a busy workload independently.

• Commercial awareness and confidence tracking budgets, variations and payments.

• Strong Excel skills and confidence using project management systems.

• Pipedrive and ServiceM8 experience is highly desirable.

• Confidence using AI tools while applying your own judgement.



We need someone who takes ownership, raises problems early and follows them through. You should not need constant reminders to complete tasks or chase outstanding actions.



How to apply



Send a one minute introductory video and your CV directly to Matt on WhatsApp:




Record and send your video directly in the WhatsApp chat. Only videos playable within the chat will be viewed. Do not send Google Drive links, cloud storage links or download links.



In your video, briefly explain:



• Your relevant project management and QA experience.

• The systems you have used, including Pipedrive or ServiceM8.

• How you keep track of multiple projects.

• One example of a mistake you prevented or a process you improved.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same chat. Confirm your earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

s directly in Klaviyo? Briefly describe it

title: Production Manager
description:
About Us



Creation Station Printing is a one-source print and promotional products company. For over a decade, we have helped businesses get their printing, promotional products, branded online storefronts, inventory management and fulfillment handled in one place. With our home base in Austin, Texas, and our warehouse in Leander, we serve business customers nationwide.



The Role



We are looking for a Production Manager who knows the vendor side of print inside and out. Many of the jobs we deliver involve our network of trusted print partners and suppliers, and this role makes sure each of those jobs is placed with the right partner, at the right price, and arrives on time.

You will own vendor sourcing, purchasing and the production calendar, from the moment an order comes in until it lands at our warehouse or the customer’s door. You will also support our customers with quotes and timeline updates.

What You’ll Do



Vendor Sourcing & Purchasing

Match each job to the right print partner or supplier based on product, decoration method, quantity, budget and deadline.

Request custom quotes from vendors for jobs that can’t be priced online, and negotiate pricing and turnaround times.

Place vendor orders and purchase orders, pay vendor carts, and keep company payment details current on vendor portals.

Own and maintain our vendor list and vendor portal logins.

Grow and strengthen our vendor network: find new partners, compare pricing, and track each partner’s quality and on-time record.



Production Scheduling & Order Tracking

Own the production calendar: schedule partner-produced jobs and move them as priorities change.

Track every vendor order from placement to delivery, following up on proofs, production status and shipping.

Make sure orders arrive on time, whether at our warehouse or directly at the customer.

Spot problems early (delays, shortages, misprints) and resolve them with the vendor before they reach the customer.

Pass approved artwork from our art team to the vendor, and relay vendor feedback (for example, a file that is too low-resolution for the ordered size) back to the art team. No design work required.

Coordinate with the warehouse team so incoming vendor shipments are expected and received, and arrange freight for larger shipments when needed.



Customer Support

Prepare and send customer quotes, including recommending the right product when a request is loosely defined.

Keep customers updated on order timelines and set clear, realistic expectations.



What You Bring

2+ years of experience in purchasing, vendor management or production coordination, ideally in printing, promotional products or apparel decoration.

Working knowledge of print and decoration methods (such as screen printing, embroidery, digital and offset printing, and large format) and which partner fits which job.

A proven ability to juggle many orders and deadlines at once without letting anything slip.

Clear, professional written communication with vendors and customers.

Comfort working in web-based ordering systems, vendor portals,
 and shared calendars.

A detail-oriented approach: you double-check quantities, specs, ship dates and costs before an order goes out.



Nice to Have

Experience with promotional products industry resources such as ASI or SAGE.

Experience with WooCommerce/WordPress order management, HubSpot or Google Workspace.

Experience arranging LTL/freight shipments.



Schedule & Details

Schedule: FULL TIME Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Central

Location: Remote with screen shared and recorded

Reports to: Ownership

Pay: $6-$12+

Benefits: Paid U.S. holidays (with the option to swap them for your local holidays), a 13th-month bonus, and two weeks of paid vacation after 6 months with the company.

Training: Hands-on training via theoretical and practical examples.

title: Customer Support Agent – Shopify Ecommerce (Full-Time, US Hours)
description:
We run two pet wellness brands (cats and dogs) selling to US customers on Shopify. Our support inbox gets 80 to 100
s a day: orders, tracking, returns, refunds, subscriptions, product questions. We're hiring ONE full-time customer support agent to own that inbox.



READ THIS FIRST

We've hired for this role before. Same pattern every time: great for the first week, then replies get slow, the inbox fills up, and we start chasing. This time we check the numbers every day from day one, and we end trials fast. If you need pushing to do your work, this isn't for you. If you're the person who empties the inbox every single shift without being asked, keep reading.



THE JOB

• Answer 80 to 100
s a day. Templates are provided for the common questions; you handle the rest with judgment.

• Reply within 2 hours during your shift. Inbox at zero at the end of every shift.

• Shopify: look up orders, fix addresses, cancel, refund within our policy, send replacements.

• Subscriptions: pause, skip and cancel requests.

• Tracking: check shipments with our fulfillment partner and keep the customer informed before they ask twice.

• Social: reply to comments and messages on
, Instagram and TikTok.

• Disputes: when a customer files a chargeback, you collect the evidence (tracking, delivery proof, the
 thread).

• End of shift: send your report in WhatsApp, 3 numbers (closed / open / escalated), every shift, without being asked.

• Templates: a new question comes in, you draft the answer, we approve it, it goes in the library. You never answer the same question from scratch twice.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, 40 hours a week, 5 days including one weekend day. The shift covers US daytime (Eastern Time), which is a night shift in the Philippines (around 10 pm to 6 am). Fixed schedule, reachable on WhatsApp during your shift.



REQUIREMENTS

• 2+ years of customer support for an ecommerce store. Shopify experience preferred.

• Excellent written English. You write simply: short sentences, simple words. Our rule: a 7-year-old could understand your reply.

• Calm with angry customers. You solve, you don't argue.

• Typing speed of 45 words per minute or more.

• Internet of 25 Mbps or more, plus a backup for internet and power. Outages are not an excuse here.

• Your own laptop.

• This is your only full-time job. We don't share you with another employer.

• Comfortable with Shopify, Gmail or a ticketing tool, Asana and WhatsApp.



PAY

$650 to $800 a month depending on experience, plus up to $100 a month in bonus for hitting the reply-time and quality targets. Paid in USD (Wise or Payoneer), on time, every time. First 30 days are a paid trial. After that, a long-term contract and a raise review every 3 months.



NOT FOR YOU IF

• You juggle several clients at the same time.

• You go quiet when it gets busy.

• You answer yes to everything in the interview and then disappear.

• You'd rather be told what to do every day than own your inbox.



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly, applications that skip a step are not read)

1. Start your message with the word CALM. Yes, this is a test.

2. Answer these in order: a. Which ecommerce store did you support, for how long, and why did it end? b. Your typing speed, with a screenshot from 
 or 10fastfingers. c. Your internet speed, with a screenshot, and your backup for internet and power. d. Can you work the night shift (US hours), 5 days including one weekend day? e. Are you currently working for another client or employer? f. Your expected monthly salary and your earliest start date.

3. Reply to these two customer
s as if you already worked for us. Your own words, no AI. We test live during the trial, so AI only hurts you.
 A: "I bought your collar 3 weeks ago. My cat still pees outside the litter box. I want my money back, this is a scam."
 B: "Tracking says delivered yesterday but I don't have the package. What now?"

4. Record a 1-minute voice or video intro (your phone is fine): who you are and why this job. Send the link.

5. Give the name and contact of your last 2 clients or employers. We will message them.



SELECTION: shortlist, then a 15-minute video call (camera on), then a paid 3-day live test on our real inbox, then the 30-day paid trial, then long-term.

We reply to every application that followed the steps.

title: Part-Time Odoo Specialist (CRM, Website, Automation, Integrations)
description:
About Us

We run two companies in Windsor, Ontario, Canada:



 • Stratus Plastics International (SPI) is an IATF 16949 certified injection molding manufacturer for the automotive and industrial sectors.

 • Stratus Ag sells ThermaRoot, a patented root-zone heating system for greenhouses.



We run both businesses on Odoo [version / Odoo Online, Odoo.sh or self-hosted]. We're replacing our outside Odoo partner with a dedicated specialist who will own our system long-term. We're an AI-first company and use tools like Claude heavily to work faster.



What You'll Do



Setup phase (first 2–3 months)



 • Audit our current Odoo setup and fix existing problems

 • Integrate 
 with Odoo CRM to sync contacts, companies and leads with no duplicates

 • Build CRM pipelines and automation rules: lead assignment, follow-up tasks,
 sequences, stage changes

 • Create call queues and dashboards for our inside sales/appointment setter

 • Build our websites in Odoo Website for SPI and Stratus Ag, and set up eCommerce for online product sales

 • Set up
 Marketing and lead capture forms on the website



Ongoing support



 • Fix bugs and user issues, usually within 24 hours

 • Plan and carry out Odoo version upgrades and module updates

 • Add new automations and reports as the business grows

 • Support our Marketing Manager with the CRM, website and campaigns



Must Have



 • 3+ years of hands-on Odoo experience. Please list the versions you've worked with.

 • Strong with CRM, Sales, Website, eCommerce,
 Marketing, Automated Actions and Studio

 • Python and Odoo development experience: custom modules, XML views, data imports and migrations

 • API and integration experience (REST, webhooks, Zapier/Make, or direct)

 • Clear written English and good documentation habits

 • Reliable internet, computer and backup power



Nice to Have



 • 
 integration experience

 • Odoo version upgrade/migration experience

 • Odoo for manufacturing (MRP, Inventory, Quality)

 • Uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) for coding and troubleshooting

 • Odoo certification



Important

title: KDP Book Production Specialist: Formatting, AI Tools & Quality Control
description:
We are a British publishing company looking for a careful, reliable person to research, create and produce AI-assisted books for Amazon KDP.



You will take books from research to upload-ready files: researching topics, writing and editing with AI tools, proofreading, formatting, quality control, images, covers and A+ Content. This is a hands-on production role. It needs someone who reads instructions closely, keeps track of their own tasks and fixes mistakes without being reminded.



TO SHOW YOU HAVE READ THIS POST, START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "KDP READY".



Responsibilities

- Research book topics, competitors and keywords

- Write and edit books using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini), following our prompts and SOPs

- Manually proofread the full text of each book, up to 30,000 words at times, checking grammar, facts, repeated or missing content and consistency

- Format interiors for paperback, hardcover and eBook (Atticus, Word, Canva)

- Check margins, gutters, bleed, trim size and page count against KDP requirements

- Create interior images and covers with AI tools and Canva

- Build A+ Content and prepare KDP uploads and metadata

- Keep a task list, acknowledge every request and post daily status updates

- Spot problems before publication and suggest fixes



Requirements

- Excellent written English and clear spoken English (we use video calls)

- Very strong attention to detail, with the patience to proofread long texts carefully

- Hands-on formatting experience with Atticus, Word or similar tools

- Comfortable with AI tools, including AI image generation

- Reads instructions carefully, asks when unsure, and does not repeat the same mistake

- Works independently, takes constructive feedback well and takes ownership of errors

- Hours: 9am to 5pm UK time, Monday to Friday (currently 5pm to 1am Philippines time), camera on for calls

- Reliable internet and power backup



KDP experience is an advantage but not essential. Strong formatting and attention to detail matter most.



Shortlisted candidates complete a short, paid skills test before any offer.



HOW TO APPLY: Answer every question below in your OWN words. Short, specific answers are better than polished ones. Applications that look copied from ChatGPT or other AI tools will be rejected.



Questions

1. Start with "KDP READY". Where are you located, and are you currently working for another employer or client?



2. Rate yourself from 1 (beginner) to 5 (expert) and say how many years or books you have used each tool for. Write "never used" if that applies.

   - Microsoft Word

   - Canva

   - Atticus

   - Affinity Publisher or Adobe InDesign

   - Kindle Create or Draft2Digital

   - Grammarly or other proofreading tools

   - Any other formatting or design tools



3. Which AI tools do you use right now? For each one, tell us your current plan (free or paid, for example "ChatGPT Plus $20 a month" or "Gemini free") and what you use it for.



4. Have you written or helped write a book or long document with AI, chapter by chapter? Describe your process and how you checked the facts.



5. AI images: which tools have you used, and how do you keep characters and style consistent across a whole book? Share links to examples.



6. Tell us about a real mistake you made at work. What happened, and what did you change afterwards?



7. Your manager says on Tuesday, "Adjust the margins, it's not urgent." On Friday they ask you to check your task list for anything missing. What do you do, and why?



8. List the five checks you would run before publishing a 30,000-word book, in order, and say why the first one is most important.



Please provide

- Resume/CV: open link (no access request needed)

- Portfolio: open link to formatted interiors, covers, Canva work or AI images

- A 60 to 90 second video or voice message (Google Drive, Loom or similar link): introduce yourself and describe one book you worked on



Only applications that answer all questions and include accessible links and the video or voice message will be considered.



This is a long-term role for someone who wants to build a career in publishing.

title: FOIA Researcher - Public Records Requests for Police Bodycam Footage
description:

 worth a video, request the footage and reports from the agency that holds them, and track every request until the files arrive. We may hire more than one person, and we're looking for people to work with us on an ongoing basis.



Picking the right i
 matters as much as the request. We want stops with a clear story and a big reaction, not routine paperwork, and we want each request in before the agency deletes the footage.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Find i
 worth requesting in news reports, agency press releases, arrest records and social media, and log the date, place, agency and case number.



- Write and submit requests through each agency's portal or by
, from our business
 and in our company's name. Ask for the bodycam and dashcam footage, the i
 or arrest report, and 911 calls where they help the story.

- Follow up on overdue requests, answer the agency's questions, and send us every cost estimate to approve before anything is paid.



- When a request is refused because the case is still open, note when to ask again, and ask again.



- Download the files before the links expire, save them to our shared Google Drive with the case details, and note in one line what's on them and whether it's worth a video.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Experience with US public records requests, ideally for bodycam footage used on YouTube.



- Clear, professional written English for
s to records offices.

- Reliability and a short daily update.



- Bonus: knowing how the public records laws differ from state to state, or experience with records portals such as GovQA, NextRequest or JustFOIA.



Workload: To start, about 20 new requests a week, plus follow-ups on every open request.

, and agency
s answered within 1 business day.

 address
